DECLARE
    v_product RECORD;
    v_location_id UUID;
    v_level RECORD;
    v_next_available INTEGER;
    v_level_json JSONB;
BEGIN
    SELECT id, store_id
      INTO v_product
      FROM products
     WHERE id = p_product_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'product not found';
    END IF;

    IF p_location_id IS NULL THEN
        v_location_id := ensure_default_inventory_location(v_product.store_id);
    ELSE
        SELECT id
          INTO v_location_id
          FROM inventory_locations
         WHERE id = p_location_id
           AND store_id = v_product.store_id
           AND deleted_at IS NULL;

        IF v_location_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory location not found for product store';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    SELECT *
      INTO v_level
      FROM inventory_levels
     WHERE product_id = p_product_id
       AND location_id = v_location_id
       AND (
            (p_variant_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL)
            OR variant_id = p_variant_id
       )
     LIMIT 1
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        v_next_available := p_adjustment;
        IF v_next_available < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot reduce inventory below zero';
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO inventory_levels (
            product_id,
            variant_id,
            location_id,
            available,
            reserved,
            incoming,
            updated_at
        )
        VALUES (
            p_product_id,
            p_variant_id,
            v_location_id,
            v_next_available,
            0,
            0,
            NOW()
        )
        RETURNING * INTO v_level;
    ELSE
        v_next_available := COALESCE(v_level.available, 0) + p_adjustment;

        IF v_next_available < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot reduce inventory below zero';
        END IF;

        IF v_next_available < COALESCE(v_level.reserved, 0) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'available inventory cannot be below reserved quantity';
        END IF;

        UPDATE inventory_levels
           SET available = v_next_available,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = v_level.id
         RETURNING * INTO v_level;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO inventory_adjustments (
        product_id,
        variant_id,
        location_id,
        quantity_change,
        reason,
        note,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_product_id,
        p_variant_id,
        v_location_id,
        p_adjustment,
        CASE
            WHEN p_reason IN ('sale', 'return', 'adjustment', 'recount', 'transfer', 'damaged', 'reserved', 'unreserved')
            THEN p_reason
            ELSE 'adjustment'
        END,
        p_notes,
        p_actor_id
    );

    IF p_variant_id IS NULL THEN
        UPDATE products
           SET stock = v_next_available,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = p_product_id;
    ELSE
        UPDATE product_variants
           SET inventory_qty = v_next_available,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = p_variant_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_product.store_id,
        'inventory',
        p_product_id::TEXT,
        'inventory.level.adjusted',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'store_id', v_product.store_id,
            'product_id', p_product_id,
            'variant_id', p_variant_id,
            'location_id', v_location_id,
            'adjustment', p_adjustment,
            'available', v_next_available
        ),
        'inventory.level.adjusted:' || p_product_id::TEXT || ':' || COALESCE(p_variant_id::TEXT, 'default') || ':' || v_location_id::TEXT || ':' || COALESCE(p_request_id, gen_random_uuid()::TEXT),
        p_request_id,
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    SELECT to_jsonb(v_level) INTO v_level_json;
    RETURN v_level_json;
END;

DECLARE
    next_stream_position BIGINT;
    inserted distributed_event_store%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    IF p_stream_name IS NULL OR length(trim(p_stream_name)) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'stream name is required';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO distributed_event_streams (
        stream_name,
        site_id,
        partition_key,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        p_stream_name,
        p_site_id,
        p_partition_key,
        jsonb_build_object('created_by_append', TRUE)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (stream_name) DO NOTHING;

    SELECT distributed_event_streams.last_stream_position + 1
      INTO next_stream_position
      FROM distributed_event_streams
     WHERE distributed_event_streams.stream_name = p_stream_name
     FOR UPDATE;

    INSERT INTO distributed_event_store (
        event_id,
        stream_name,
        stream_position,
        partition_key,
        site_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        schema_version,
        payload,
        metadata,
        source_runtime,
        producer,
        correlation_id,
        causation_id,
        request_id,
        trace_id,
        idempotency_key,
        replayable,
        retention_class
    )
    VALUES (
        p_event_id,
        p_stream_name,
        next_stream_position,
        p_partition_key,
        p_site_id,
        p_aggregate_type,
        p_aggregate_id,
        p_event_type,
        COALESCE(p_schema_version, 1),
        COALESCE(p_payload, '{}'),
        COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'),
        p_source_runtime,
        p_producer,
        p_correlation_id,
        p_causation_id,
        p_request_id,
        p_trace_id,
        p_idempotency_key,
        COALESCE(p_replayable, TRUE),
        COALESCE(p_retention_class, 'hot')
    )
    ON CONFLICT (stream_name, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING * INTO inserted;

    IF inserted.id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT *
          INTO inserted
          FROM distributed_event_store
         WHERE distributed_event_store.stream_name = p_stream_name
           AND distributed_event_store.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
         LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    UPDATE distributed_event_streams
       SET last_stream_position = GREATEST(last_stream_position, inserted.stream_position),
           last_global_position = GREATEST(last_global_position, inserted.global_position),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE distributed_event_streams.stream_name = p_stream_name;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        inserted.event_id,
        inserted.stream_name,
        inserted.stream_position,
        inserted.global_position,
        inserted.persisted_at;
END;

DECLARE
    affected_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT id
          FROM distributed_event_store
         WHERE retention_class IN ('hot', 'warm')
           AND replayable = TRUE
           AND occurred_at < p_before
           AND deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
         LIMIT p_limit
    )
    UPDATE distributed_event_store AS event
       SET retention_class = 'archive',
           updated_at = NOW()
      FROM candidates
     WHERE event.id = candidates.id;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS affected_count = ROW_COUNT;
    RETURN affected_count;
END;

DECLARE
    v_order_json JSONB;
    v_order RECORD;
    v_payment_transaction_id UUID;
BEGIN
    v_order_json := attach_order_payment_reference(
        p_order_id,
        p_provider,
        p_provider_order_id,
        p_request_id
    );

    SELECT *
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    UPDATE payment_transactions
       SET gateway_txn_id = p_provider_order_id,
           provider_order_id = p_provider_order_id,
           request_id = COALESCE(p_request_id, request_id),
           idempotency_key = COALESCE(p_idempotency_key, idempotency_key),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE order_id = p_order_id
       AND gateway = p_provider
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;

    IF v_payment_transaction_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO payment_transactions (
            order_id,
            store_id,
            site_id,
            gateway,
            gateway_txn_id,
            provider_order_id,
            amount,
            currency,
            status,
            payment_method,
            metadata,
            request_id,
            idempotency_key
        )
        VALUES (
            p_order_id,
            v_order.store_id,
            v_order.store_id,
            p_provider,
            p_provider_order_id,
            p_provider_order_id,
            COALESCE(v_order.total, 0),
            COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
            'pending',
            p_provider,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'payment_reference_attach'),
            p_request_id,
            p_idempotency_key
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO payment_attempts (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        payment_transaction_id,
        provider,
        attempt_type,
        status,
        amount,
        currency,
        provider_order_id,
        provider_event_id,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        p_order_id,
        v_payment_transaction_id,
        p_provider,
        'reference',
        'succeeded',
        COALESCE(v_order.total, 0),
        COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
        p_provider_order_id,
        'reference:' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_order_id,
        p_idempotency_key,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object('provider_order_id', p_provider_order_id)
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

    RETURN v_order_json;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT id
          FROM distributed_queue_messages
         WHERE queue_name = p_queue_name
           AND status IN ('scheduled', 'available', 'retrying')
           AND available_at <= NOW()
           AND deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY partition_index ASC, available_at ASC, created_at ASC
         LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 25), 1), 250)
         FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    )
    UPDATE distributed_queue_messages AS message
       SET status = 'leased',
           attempts = attempts + 1,
           leased_by = p_worker_id,
           leased_until = NOW() + make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(p_visibility_seconds, 120), 1)),
           fencing_token = encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex'),
           updated_at = NOW()
      FROM candidates
     WHERE message.id = candidates.id
    RETURNING message.*;
END;

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT id
          FROM runtime_control_commands
         WHERE status = 'accepted'
           AND deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY created_at ASC
         LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 25), 1), 100)
         FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    )
    UPDATE runtime_control_commands AS command
       SET status = 'running',
           result = jsonb_build_object('owner_id', p_owner_id, 'claimed_at', NOW()),
           updated_at = NOW()
      FROM candidates
     WHERE command.id = candidates.id
    RETURNING command.*;
END;

BEGIN
    IF p_dispatcher_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_dispatcher_id)) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'dispatcher id is required';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT outbox_events.id
        FROM outbox_events
        WHERE outbox_events.status IN ('queued', 'failed')
          AND outbox_events.available_at <= NOW()
          AND outbox_events.next_attempt_at <= NOW()
          AND outbox_events.attempts < outbox_events.max_attempts
          AND (
              outbox_events.locked_at IS NULL
              OR outbox_events.locked_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => p_lock_seconds)
          )
        ORDER BY outbox_events.created_at ASC
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_limit, 1), 100)
    ),
    claimed AS (
        UPDATE outbox_events
           SET status = 'processing',
               attempts = outbox_events.attempts + 1,
               locked_at = NOW(),
               locked_by = p_dispatcher_id,
               error_message = NULL,
               updated_at = NOW()
          FROM candidates
         WHERE outbox_events.id = candidates.id
         RETURNING outbox_events.*
    )
    SELECT
        claimed.id,
        claimed.store_id,
        COALESCE(claimed.site_id, claimed.store_id) AS site_id,
        claimed.event_id,
        claimed.aggregate_type,
        claimed.aggregate_id,
        claimed.event_type,
        claimed.payload,
        claimed.idempotency_key,
        claimed.request_id,
        claimed.trace_id,
        claimed.schema_version,
        claimed.actor_id,
        claimed.attempts,
        claimed.max_attempts,
        claimed.created_at
    FROM claimed;
END;

BEGIN
    IF p_queue_name IS NULL OR length(trim(p_queue_name)) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'queue name is required';
    END IF;

    IF p_worker_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_worker_id)) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'worker id is required';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT platform_queue_jobs.id
        FROM platform_queue_jobs
        WHERE platform_queue_jobs.queue_name = p_queue_name
          AND platform_queue_jobs.status IN ('queued', 'failed')
          AND platform_queue_jobs.available_at <= NOW()
          AND platform_queue_jobs.attempts < platform_queue_jobs.max_attempts
          AND platform_queue_jobs.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
              platform_queue_jobs.locked_at IS NULL
              OR platform_queue_jobs.locked_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => p_lock_seconds)
          )
        ORDER BY platform_queue_jobs.created_at ASC
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_limit, 1), 100)
    ),
    claimed AS (
        UPDATE platform_queue_jobs
           SET status = 'running',
               attempts = platform_queue_jobs.attempts + 1,
               locked_at = NOW(),
               locked_by = p_worker_id,
               error_message = NULL,
               updated_at = NOW()
          FROM candidates
         WHERE platform_queue_jobs.id = candidates.id
         RETURNING platform_queue_jobs.*
    )
    SELECT
        claimed.id,
        claimed.site_id,
        claimed.outbox_event_id,
        claimed.event_id,
        claimed.queue_name,
        claimed.job_type,
        claimed.payload,
        claimed.attempts,
        claimed.max_attempts,
        claimed.request_id,
        claimed.trace_id,
        claimed.idempotency_key,
        claimed.schema_version
    FROM claimed;
END;

DECLARE
    claimed runtime_leases%ROWTYPE;
    token TEXT := encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex');
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO runtime_leases (
        lease_id,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        owner_id,
        fencing_token,
        expires_at,
        request_id,
        correlation_id,
        trace_id
    )
    VALUES (
        p_resource_type || ':' || p_resource_id,
        p_resource_type,
        p_resource_id,
        p_owner_id,
        token,
        NOW() + make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(p_ttl_seconds, 60), 1)),
        p_request_id,
        p_correlation_id,
        p_trace_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (resource_type, resource_id) DO UPDATE
       SET owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id,
           fencing_token = EXCLUDED.fencing_token,
           expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
           request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id,
           correlation_id = EXCLUDED.correlation_id,
           trace_id = EXCLUDED.trace_id,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE runtime_leases.expires_at <= NOW()
        OR runtime_leases.owner_id = p_owner_id
    RETURNING * INTO claimed;

    IF claimed.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'runtime lease unavailable for %.%', p_resource_type, p_resource_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN claimed;
END;

BEGIN
    IF p_dispatcher_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_dispatcher_id)) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'dispatcher id is required';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT webhook_deliveries.id
        FROM webhook_deliveries
        JOIN webhook_subscriptions
          ON webhook_subscriptions.id = webhook_deliveries.subscription_id
         AND webhook_subscriptions.status = 'active'
         AND webhook_subscriptions.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE webhook_deliveries.status IN ('pending', 'failed')
          AND webhook_deliveries.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND webhook_deliveries.next_attempt_at <= NOW()
          AND webhook_deliveries.attempts < webhook_deliveries.max_attempts
          AND (
              webhook_deliveries.locked_at IS NULL
              OR webhook_deliveries.locked_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => p_lock_seconds)
          )
        ORDER BY webhook_deliveries.created_at ASC
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_limit, 1), 100)
    ),
    claimed AS (
        UPDATE webhook_deliveries
           SET status = 'processing',
               attempts = webhook_deliveries.attempts + 1,
               locked_at = NOW(),
               locked_by = p_dispatcher_id,
               error_message = NULL,
               updated_at = NOW()
          FROM candidates
         WHERE webhook_deliveries.id = candidates.id
         RETURNING webhook_deliveries.*
    )
    SELECT
        claimed.id,
        claimed.site_id,
        claimed.subscription_id,
        claimed.event_id,
        claimed.event_type,
        claimed.target_url,
        claimed.payload,
        webhook_subscriptions.signing_secret,
        claimed.request_id,
        claimed.trace_id,
        claimed.idempotency_key,
        claimed.schema_version,
        claimed.attempts,
        claimed.max_attempts
    FROM claimed
    JOIN webhook_subscriptions ON webhook_subscriptions.id = claimed.subscription_id;
END;

DECLARE
  v_refund record;
  v_order record;
  v_total_succeeded numeric(12,2);
  v_existing_succeeded numeric(12,2);
  v_order_total numeric(12,2);
  v_payment_status text;
  v_amount_minor bigint;
  v_ledger_transaction_id uuid;
  v_ledger_idempotency_key text;
  v_existing_post public.ledger_transactions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR btrim(p_idempotency_key) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_key is required';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_refund
    FROM refunds
   WHERE id = p_refund_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'refund not found';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_order
    FROM orders
   WHERE id = v_refund.order_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
  END IF;

  -- A refund is one monetary source, regardless of transport receipt keys.
  -- Reuse its committed posting; never invoke the ledger again under a new key.
  IF NULLIF(p_provider_refund_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND v_refund.provider_refund_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p_provider_refund_id<>v_refund.provider_refund_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'refund provider reference conflict' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF v_refund.status<>'succeeded' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ledger_transactions WHERE site_id=v_refund.site_id AND source_type='refund' AND source_id='refund:'||p_refund_id::text) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'refund source already posted; reconciliation is required'; END IF;
  IF v_refund.status='succeeded' THEN
    IF NULLIF(p_provider_refund_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND p_provider_refund_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_refund.provider_refund_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'refund provider reference conflict' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
    IF round(coalesce(v_refund.amount,0)*100)::bigint>0 THEN
      IF coalesce(v_refund.metadata->>'canonical_ledger_transaction_id','')!~'^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'succeeded refund requires its matching canonical posting'; END IF;
      SELECT * INTO v_existing_post FROM public.ledger_transactions
       WHERE id=nullif(v_refund.metadata->>'canonical_ledger_transaction_id','')::uuid
        AND site_id=v_refund.site_id AND currency='INR' AND source_type='refund' AND source_id='refund:'||p_refund_id::text;
      IF v_existing_post.id IS NULL OR
        (SELECT count(*)FROM public.ledger_transactions WHERE site_id=v_refund.site_id AND source_type='refund'AND source_id='refund:'||p_refund_id::text)<>1 OR
        (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor),0) FROM public.ledger_entries WHERE transaction_id=v_existing_post.id AND side='debit')<>round(v_refund.amount*100)::bigint THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'succeeded refund requires its matching canonical posting'; END IF;
      v_ledger_transaction_id:=v_existing_post.id;
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) INTO v_total_succeeded FROM public.refunds
     WHERE site_id=v_refund.site_id AND order_id=v_refund.order_id AND status='succeeded' AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('order',to_jsonb(v_order),'refund',to_jsonb(v_refund),
      'total_refunded',v_total_succeeded,'canonical_ledger_transaction_id',v_ledger_transaction_id);
  END IF;

  v_order_total := COALESCE(v_order.total, 0);
  v_amount_minor := round(COALESCE(v_refund.amount, 0) * 100)::bigint;
  v_ledger_idempotency_key := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_idempotency_key, ''), NULLIF(v_refund.idempotency_key, ''), p_provider_refund_id, p_refund_id::text);

  IF v_refund.status <> 'succeeded' THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
      INTO v_existing_succeeded
      FROM refunds
     WHERE order_id = v_refund.order_id
       AND site_id = v_refund.site_id
       AND status = 'succeeded'
       AND id <> p_refund_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF v_existing_succeeded + COALESCE(v_refund.amount, 0) > v_order_total THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'refund amount exceeds captured order total';
    END IF;

    UPDATE refunds
       SET status = 'succeeded',
           provider_refund_id = COALESCE(p_provider_refund_id, provider_refund_id),
           provider_event_id = COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, provider_event_id),
           updated_at = now(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE id = p_refund_id;

    UPDATE refund_transactions
       SET status = 'succeeded',
           provider_refund_id = COALESCE(p_provider_refund_id, provider_refund_id),
           provider_event_id = COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, provider_event_id),
           updated_at = now(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE order_id = v_refund.order_id
       AND site_id = v_refund.site_id
       AND metadata ->> 'refund_id' = p_refund_id::text
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  END IF;

  IF v_amount_minor > 0 THEN
    v_ledger_transaction_id := public.post_settlement_ledger_transaction(
      v_refund.site_id,
      'refund',
      'refund:' || p_refund_id::text,
      v_ledger_idempotency_key,
      jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code', 'merchant_payable',
          'side', 'debit',
          'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
          'memo', 'Refund merchant payable reversal ' || p_refund_id::text
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code', 'refund_clearing',
          'side', 'credit',
          'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
          'memo', 'Refund clearing ' || p_refund_id::text
        )
      ),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'compatibility_table', 'refunds',
        'refund_id', p_refund_id,
        'payment_transaction_id', v_refund.payment_transaction_id,
        'order_id', v_refund.order_id,
        'provider_refund_id', p_provider_refund_id,
        'provider_event_id', p_provider_event_id
      ),
      p_request_id
    );

    UPDATE refunds
       SET metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
         || jsonb_build_object('canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = p_refund_id;

    UPDATE refund_transactions
       SET metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
         || jsonb_build_object('canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE order_id = v_refund.order_id
       AND site_id = v_refund.site_id
       AND metadata ->> 'refund_id' = p_refund_id::text
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO refund_attempts (
    site_id,
    refund_transaction_id,
    provider,
    status,
    provider_refund_id,
    provider_event_id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_id,
    metadata,
    created_by
  )
  SELECT
    rt.site_id,
    rt.id,
    CASE
      WHEN v_refund.provider IN ('stripe', 'razorpay', 'paypal', 'cod', 'bank_transfer', 'gift_card') THEN v_refund.provider
      WHEN v_refund.refund_method = 'gift_card' THEN 'gift_card'
      WHEN v_refund.refund_method = 'manual' THEN 'bank_transfer'
      WHEN v_order.payment_gateway IN ('stripe', 'razorpay', 'paypal', 'cod', 'bank_transfer') THEN v_order.payment_gateway
      WHEN v_order.payment_method IN ('stripe', 'razorpay', 'paypal', 'cod', 'bank_transfer') THEN v_order.payment_method
      ELSE 'bank_transfer'
    END,
    'succeeded',
    p_provider_refund_id,
    p_provider_event_id,
    v_ledger_idempotency_key,
    p_request_id,
    jsonb_build_object('refund_id', p_refund_id, 'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id),
    p_actor_id
  FROM refund_transactions rt
  WHERE rt.order_id = v_refund.order_id
    AND rt.site_id = v_refund.site_id
    AND rt.metadata ->> 'refund_id' = p_refund_id::text
    AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)
    INTO v_total_succeeded
    FROM refunds
   WHERE order_id = v_refund.order_id
     AND site_id = v_refund.site_id
     AND status = 'succeeded'
     AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  v_payment_status := CASE WHEN v_total_succeeded >= v_order_total THEN 'refunded' ELSE 'partially_refunded' END;

  UPDATE payment_transactions
     SET status = v_payment_status,
         refunded_at = CASE WHEN v_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN COALESCE(refunded_at, now()) ELSE refunded_at END,
         updated_at = now(),
         updated_by = p_actor_id
   WHERE id = v_refund.payment_transaction_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  UPDATE returns
     SET status = 'refunded',
         refunded_at = now(),
         updated_at = now(),
         updated_by = p_actor_id
   WHERE id = v_refund.return_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  UPDATE orders
     SET refund_status = CASE WHEN v_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 'refunded' ELSE 'partially_refunded' END,
         payment_status = CASE WHEN v_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 'refunded' ELSE payment_status END,
         status = CASE WHEN v_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 'refunded' ELSE status END,
         return_status = 'refunded',
         updated_at = now(),
         updated_by = p_actor_id
   WHERE id = v_refund.order_id;

  INSERT INTO outbox_events (
    site_id,
    store_id,
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    event_type,
    payload,
    idempotency_key,
    request_id,
    trace_id,
    schema_version,
    actor_id
  )
  VALUES (
    v_refund.site_id,
    v_refund.site_id,
    'refund',
    p_refund_id::text,
    'refund.succeeded',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'site_id', v_refund.site_id,
      'order_id', v_refund.order_id,
      'refund_id', p_refund_id,
      'amount', v_refund.amount,
      'provider_refund_id', p_provider_refund_id,
      'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id
    ),
    'refund.succeeded:' || p_refund_id::text,
    p_request_id,
    p_request_id,
    1,
    p_actor_id
  )
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'order', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM orders o WHERE o.id = v_refund.order_id),
    'refund', (SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM refunds r WHERE r.id = p_refund_id),
    'total_refunded', v_total_succeeded,
    'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id
  );
END;

DECLARE
    v_event outbox_events;
BEGIN
    UPDATE outbox_events
       SET status = 'processed',
           locked_at = NULL,
           locked_by = NULL,
           processed_at = NOW(),
           dispatched_at = NOW(),
           error_message = NULL,
           dispatch_metadata = COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
               || jsonb_build_object(
                   'delivery_count', COALESCE(p_delivery_count, 0),
                   'job_count', COALESCE(p_job_count, 0),
                   'completed_at', NOW()
               ),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE outbox_events.id = p_event_id
       AND outbox_events.status = 'processing'
       AND outbox_events.locked_by = p_dispatcher_id
     RETURNING * INTO v_event;

    IF v_event.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox event % is not claimable by dispatcher %', p_event_id, p_dispatcher_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_event;
END;

DECLARE
    v_job platform_queue_jobs;
BEGIN
    UPDATE platform_queue_jobs
       SET status = 'succeeded',
           locked_at = NULL,
           locked_by = NULL,
           completed_at = NOW(),
           failed_at = NULL,
           error_message = NULL,
           result = COALESCE(p_result, '{}'::JSONB),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = p_job_id
       AND status = 'running'
       AND locked_by = p_worker_id
     RETURNING * INTO v_job;

    IF v_job.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'queue job % is not claimable by worker %', p_job_id, p_worker_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_job;
END;

DECLARE
    v_delivery webhook_deliveries;
BEGIN
    UPDATE webhook_deliveries
       SET status = 'succeeded',
           locked_at = NULL,
           locked_by = NULL,
           delivered_at = NOW(),
           failed_at = NULL,
           response_status = p_response_status,
           response_body_preview = LEFT(COALESCE(p_response_body_preview, ''), 2000),
           error_message = NULL,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = p_delivery_id
       AND status = 'processing'
       AND locked_by = p_dispatcher_id
     RETURNING * INTO v_delivery;

    IF v_delivery.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'webhook delivery % is not claimable by dispatcher %', p_delivery_id, p_dispatcher_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE webhook_subscriptions
       SET failure_count = 0,
           last_success_at = NOW(),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_delivery.subscription_id;

    RETURN v_delivery;
END;

DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_event_id TEXT;
    v_order_json JSONB;
BEGIN
    IF p_order_id IS NULL OR p_provider IS NULL OR p_provider_payment_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_id, provider, and provider_payment_id are required';
    END IF;

    v_event_id := COALESCE(
        NULLIF(p_provider_event_id, ''),
        p_provider || ':payment:' || p_provider_payment_id
    );

    SELECT id, store_id, payment_id, payment_status, status
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_order.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order is not payable';
    END IF;

    IF p_provider_order_id IS NOT NULL
       AND v_order.payment_id IS NOT NULL
       AND v_order.payment_id <> p_provider_order_id
       AND v_order.payment_id <> p_provider_payment_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment reference mismatch';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO payment_webhook_events (
        provider,
        provider_event_id,
        event_type,
        signature_valid,
        processing_status,
        raw_payload,
        processed_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_provider,
        v_event_id,
        'checkout.payment.confirmed',
        TRUE,
        'processed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'provider', p_provider,
            'provider_order_id', p_provider_order_id,
            'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
            'request_id', p_request_id
        ),
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        signature_valid = TRUE,
        processing_status = 'processed',
        processed_at = COALESCE(payment_webhook_events.processed_at, NOW()),
        updated_at = NOW();

    IF v_order.payment_status = 'paid' THEN
        SELECT to_jsonb(o)
          INTO v_order_json
          FROM orders o
         WHERE o.id = p_order_id;
        RETURN v_order_json;
    END IF;

    UPDATE orders
       SET payment_status = 'paid',
           payment_id = p_provider_payment_id,
           payment_method = p_provider,
           payment_gateway = p_provider,
           status = 'confirmed',
           payment_processed_at = NOW(),
           last_payment_event_id = v_event_id,
           payment_failure_reason = NULL,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = p_order_id
     RETURNING to_jsonb(orders.*) INTO v_order_json;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        'order',
        p_order_id::TEXT,
        'payment.confirmed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'store_id', v_order.store_id,
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'provider', p_provider,
            'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
            'provider_event_id', v_event_id
        ),
        'payment.confirmed:' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id,
        p_request_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO audit_activity_events (
        store_id,
        actor_type,
        action,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        request_id,
        after_state
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        'webhook',
        'payment.confirm',
        'order',
        p_order_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'provider', p_provider,
            'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
            'provider_event_id', v_event_id
        )
    );

    RETURN v_order_json;
END;

DECLARE
  v_order_json jsonb;
  v_order record;
  v_payment_transaction_id uuid;
  v_site_id uuid;
  v_amount_minor bigint;
  v_ledger_transaction_id uuid;
  v_ledger_idempotency_key text;
  -- F-PAY4-1 (252): the order as it stands when this capture arrives, and what the capture means for it.
  v_state record;
  v_unfulfillable_reason text;
  v_event_id text;
BEGIN
  IF p_provider_payment_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_provider_payment_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'provider_payment_id is required';
  END IF;

  -- F-PAY4-1 (252): lock the order before anything is written and classify the capture against it.
  -- Every confirmation of this order — the verify callback, the webhook, their retries — serializes on
  -- this row lock, and so does the unpaid-reservation sweep (211 locks the same row FOR UPDATE SKIP
  -- LOCKED), so what is read here is what the rest of this transaction acts on.
  SELECT *
    INTO v_state
    FROM orders
   WHERE id = p_order_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
  END IF;

  v_site_id := COALESCE(v_state.site_id, v_state.store_id);

  -- Binding: the same predicate confirm_order_payment applies, repeated here because the
  -- unfulfillable branch below never reaches that function. A capture for a provider order this
  -- order was not bound to is never recorded against it.
  IF p_provider_order_id IS NOT NULL
     AND v_state.payment_id IS NOT NULL
     AND v_state.payment_id <> p_provider_order_id
     AND v_state.payment_id <> p_provider_payment_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment reference mismatch';
  END IF;

  -- Duplicate: this order is already paid by THIS provider payment. One provider payment is one
  -- ledger capture, whichever path (verify callback, webhook, retry) reports it.
  IF v_state.payment_id = p_provider_payment_id
     AND v_state.payment_status IN ('paid', 'refunded') THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(o) INTO v_order_json FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id;
    RETURN v_order_json || jsonb_build_object(
      'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', (
        SELECT lt.id
          FROM ledger_transactions lt
         WHERE lt.site_id = v_site_id
           AND lt.source_type = 'payment_capture'
           AND lt.source_id = p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id
         ORDER BY lt.created_at
         LIMIT 1
      ),
      'capture_outcome', 'duplicate',
      'fulfillable', (v_state.payment_status = 'paid' AND v_state.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')),
      'unfulfillable_reason', (
        SELECT ca.payload ->> 'reason'
          FROM compensation_actions ca
         WHERE ca.site_id = v_site_id
           AND ca.flow = 'checkout_confirm'
           AND ca.idempotency_key = 'refund_captured_payment:' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id
           AND ca.deleted_at IS NULL
         LIMIT 1
      )
    );
  END IF;

  -- Paid by a DIFFERENT provider payment. With a provider order id present the binding check above
  -- has already raised this; the explicit raise closes the path where no provider order id is sent.
  IF v_state.payment_status = 'paid' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order is already paid by a different payment';
  END IF;

  -- Unfulfillable: never captured before, and it can no longer be fulfilled.
  IF v_state.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN
    v_unfulfillable_reason := 'order_' || v_state.status;
  ELSIF v_state.inventory_released_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_unfulfillable_reason := 'reservation_released';
  END IF;

  IF v_unfulfillable_reason IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_amount_minor := round(COALESCE(v_state.total, 0) * 100)::bigint;
    v_ledger_idempotency_key := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_idempotency_key, ''), p_provider_payment_id);
    v_event_id := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_provider_event_id, ''), p_provider || ':payment:' || p_provider_payment_id);

    -- The provider event is recorded exactly as confirm_order_payment would record it.
    INSERT INTO payment_webhook_events (
      provider,
      provider_event_id,
      event_type,
      signature_valid,
      processing_status,
      raw_payload,
      processed_at
    )
    VALUES (
      p_provider,
      v_event_id,
      'checkout.payment.captured_unfulfillable',
      TRUE,
      'processed',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id', p_order_id,
        'provider', p_provider,
        'provider_order_id', p_provider_order_id,
        'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
        'reason', v_unfulfillable_reason,
        'request_id', p_request_id
      ),
      now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
      signature_valid = TRUE,
      processing_status = 'processed',
      processed_at = COALESCE(payment_webhook_events.processed_at, now()),
      updated_at = now();

    -- The money: this order was never captured, so its one payment row (attach's 'pending', or
    -- payment.failed's 'failed') becomes the captured row — one row per (order, gateway), as 107 keeps it.
    UPDATE payment_transactions
       SET gateway_txn_id = COALESCE(p_provider_payment_id, gateway_txn_id),
           provider_order_id = COALESCE(p_provider_order_id, provider_order_id),
           provider_payment_id = p_provider_payment_id,
           provider_event_id = COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, provider_event_id),
           status = 'captured',
           captured_at = COALESCE(captured_at, now()),
           request_id = COALESCE(p_request_id, request_id),
           idempotency_key = COALESCE(v_ledger_idempotency_key, idempotency_key),
           metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
             || jsonb_build_object('unfulfillable_capture', v_unfulfillable_reason),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE order_id = p_order_id
       AND gateway = p_provider
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;

    IF v_payment_transaction_id IS NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO payment_transactions (
        order_id,
        store_id,
        site_id,
        gateway,
        gateway_txn_id,
        provider_order_id,
        provider_payment_id,
        provider_event_id,
        amount,
        currency,
        status,
        payment_method,
        metadata,
        request_id,
        idempotency_key,
        captured_at
      )
      VALUES (
        p_order_id,
        v_state.store_id,
        v_site_id,
        p_provider,
        p_provider_payment_id,
        p_provider_order_id,
        p_provider_payment_id,
        p_provider_event_id,
        COALESCE(v_state.total, 0),
        COALESCE(v_state.currency, 'INR'),
        'captured',
        p_provider,
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'payment_confirmation', 'unfulfillable_capture', v_unfulfillable_reason),
        p_request_id,
        v_ledger_idempotency_key,
        now()
      )
      RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;
    END IF;

    -- Booked exactly as a normal capture, so the provider's refund.processed reverses it through the
    -- existing path (merchant_payable debit / refund_clearing credit) and nets to zero.
    IF v_amount_minor > 0 THEN
      v_ledger_transaction_id := public.post_settlement_ledger_transaction(
        v_site_id,
        'payment_capture',
        p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id,
        v_ledger_idempotency_key,
        jsonb_build_array(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'account_code', 'pa_clearing',
            'side', 'debit',
            'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
            'memo', 'Payment capture ' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id
          ),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'account_code', 'merchant_payable',
            'side', 'credit',
            'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
            'memo', 'Merchant payable capture ' || p_order_id::text || ' (unfulfillable: ' || v_unfulfillable_reason || ')'
          )
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
          'compatibility_table', 'payment_transactions',
          'payment_transaction_id', v_payment_transaction_id,
          'order_id', p_order_id,
          'provider', p_provider,
          'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
          'provider_order_id', p_provider_order_id,
          'provider_event_id', p_provider_event_id,
          'unfulfillable_reason', v_unfulfillable_reason
        ),
        p_request_id
      );

      UPDATE payment_transactions
         SET metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
           || jsonb_build_object('canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id),
             updated_at = now()
       WHERE id = v_payment_transaction_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO payment_attempts (
      site_id,
      order_id,
      payment_transaction_id,
      provider,
      attempt_type,
      status,
      amount,
      currency,
      provider_order_id,
      provider_payment_id,
      provider_event_id,
      idempotency_key,
      request_id,
      metadata
    )
    VALUES (
      v_site_id,
      p_order_id,
      v_payment_transaction_id,
      p_provider,
      'capture',
      'succeeded',
      COALESCE(v_state.total, 0),
      COALESCE(v_state.currency, 'INR'),
      p_provider_order_id,
      p_provider_payment_id,
      COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, 'capture:' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id),
      v_ledger_idempotency_key,
      p_request_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
        'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id,
        'unfulfillable_reason', v_unfulfillable_reason
      )
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

    -- The order leaves the fulfilment path; the money it took is owed back.
    UPDATE orders
       SET payment_status = 'paid',
           payment_id = p_provider_payment_id,
           payment_method = p_provider,
           payment_gateway = p_provider,
           status = 'cancelled',
           fulfillment_state = 'cancelled',
           refund_status = 'pending',
           payment_processed_at = now(),
           last_payment_event_id = v_event_id,
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = p_order_id;

    INSERT INTO compensation_actions (
      site_id,
      flow,
      aggregate_type,
      aggregate_id,
      idempotency_key,
      status,
      action,
      payload,
      request_id
    )
    VALUES (
      v_site_id,
      'checkout_confirm',
      'order',
      p_order_id,
      'refund_captured_payment:' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id,
      'pending',
      'refund_captured_payment',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'reason', v_unfulfillable_reason,
        'provider', p_provider,
        'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
        'provider_order_id', p_provider_order_id,
        'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
        'currency', COALESCE(v_state.currency, 'INR'),
        'payment_transaction_id', v_payment_transaction_id,
        'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id
      ),
      p_request_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, flow, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    -- The contracted event (packages/event-core 'order.cancelled', OrderPayloadSchema fields only), in
    -- the same transaction as the state change it announces.
    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
      site_id,
      store_id,
      aggregate_type,
      aggregate_id,
      event_type,
      payload,
      idempotency_key,
      request_id,
      trace_id,
      schema_version
    )
    VALUES (
      v_site_id,
      v_state.store_id,
      'order',
      p_order_id::text,
      'order.cancelled',
      -- orders carries no customer_id column (customer_email/_name/_phone/_gstin only), so the
      -- contract's optional customer_id is omitted, exactly as the gateway's order.paid emitter ends up doing.
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'site_id', v_site_id,
        'order_id', p_order_id,
        'order_number', NULLIF(v_state.order_number, ''),
        'total', jsonb_build_object('amount_minor', v_amount_minor, 'currency', 'INR')
      )),
      'order.cancelled:' || p_order_id::text || ':captured_unfulfillable',
      p_request_id,
      p_request_id,
      1
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO audit_activity_events (
      store_id,
      actor_type,
      action,
      resource_type,
      resource_id,
      request_id,
      after_state
    )
    VALUES (
      v_state.store_id,
      'webhook',
      'payment.captured_unfulfillable',
      'order',
      p_order_id::text,
      p_request_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id', p_order_id,
        'reason', v_unfulfillable_reason,
        'provider', p_provider,
        'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
        'provider_event_id', v_event_id,
        'previous_status', v_state.status,
        'previous_payment_status', v_state.payment_status
      )
    );

    SELECT to_jsonb(o) INTO v_order_json FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id;
    RETURN v_order_json || jsonb_build_object(
      'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id,
      'capture_outcome', 'captured_unfulfillable',
      'fulfillable', false,
      'unfulfillable_reason', v_unfulfillable_reason
    );
  END IF;

  -- Confirmed: the live 168 definition from here on, unchanged.
  v_order_json := confirm_order_payment(
    p_order_id,
    p_provider,
    p_provider_payment_id,
    p_provider_order_id,
    p_provider_event_id,
    p_request_id
  );

  SELECT *
    INTO v_order
    FROM orders
   WHERE id = p_order_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
  END IF;

  v_site_id := COALESCE(v_order.site_id, v_order.store_id);
  v_amount_minor := round(COALESCE(v_order.total, 0) * 100)::bigint;
  v_ledger_idempotency_key := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_idempotency_key, ''), p_provider_payment_id);

  UPDATE payment_transactions
     SET gateway_txn_id = COALESCE(p_provider_payment_id, gateway_txn_id),
         provider_order_id = COALESCE(p_provider_order_id, provider_order_id),
         provider_payment_id = p_provider_payment_id,
         provider_event_id = COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, provider_event_id),
         status = 'captured',
         captured_at = COALESCE(captured_at, now()),
         request_id = COALESCE(p_request_id, request_id),
         idempotency_key = COALESCE(v_ledger_idempotency_key, idempotency_key),
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE order_id = p_order_id
     AND gateway = p_provider
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;

  IF v_payment_transaction_id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO payment_transactions (
      order_id,
      store_id,
      site_id,
      gateway,
      gateway_txn_id,
      provider_order_id,
      provider_payment_id,
      provider_event_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      status,
      payment_method,
      metadata,
      request_id,
      idempotency_key,
      captured_at
    )
    VALUES (
      p_order_id,
      v_order.store_id,
      v_site_id,
      p_provider,
      p_provider_payment_id,
      p_provider_order_id,
      p_provider_payment_id,
      p_provider_event_id,
      COALESCE(v_order.total, 0),
      COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
      'captured',
      p_provider,
      jsonb_build_object('source', 'payment_confirmation'),
      p_request_id,
      v_ledger_idempotency_key,
      now()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_amount_minor > 0 THEN
    v_ledger_transaction_id := public.post_settlement_ledger_transaction(
      v_site_id,
      'payment_capture',
      p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id,
      v_ledger_idempotency_key,
      jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code', 'pa_clearing',
          'side', 'debit',
          'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
          'memo', 'Payment capture ' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code', 'merchant_payable',
          'side', 'credit',
          'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
          'memo', 'Merchant payable capture ' || p_order_id::text
        )
      ),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'compatibility_table', 'payment_transactions',
        'payment_transaction_id', v_payment_transaction_id,
        'order_id', p_order_id,
        'provider', p_provider,
        'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id,
        'provider_order_id', p_provider_order_id,
        'provider_event_id', p_provider_event_id
      ),
      p_request_id
    );

    UPDATE payment_transactions
       SET metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
         || jsonb_build_object('canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = v_payment_transaction_id;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO payment_attempts (
    site_id,
    order_id,
    payment_transaction_id,
    provider,
    attempt_type,
    status,
    amount,
    currency,
    provider_order_id,
    provider_payment_id,
    provider_event_id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_id,
    metadata
  )
  VALUES (
    v_site_id,
    p_order_id,
    v_payment_transaction_id,
    p_provider,
    'capture',
    'succeeded',
    COALESCE(v_order.total, 0),
    COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
    p_provider_order_id,
    p_provider_payment_id,
    COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, 'capture:' || p_provider || ':' || p_provider_payment_id),
    v_ledger_idempotency_key,
    p_request_id,
    jsonb_build_object('provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id, 'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id)
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  RETURN v_order_json || jsonb_build_object(
    'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id,
    'capture_outcome', 'confirmed',
    'fulfillable', true
  );
END;

DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_existing_id UUID;
    v_fulfillment_id UUID;
    v_shipment_id UUID;
    v_line RECORD;
    v_item RECORD;
    v_quantity INTEGER;
    v_remaining INTEGER;
    v_line_count INTEGER := 0;
    v_all_fulfilled BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
    IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_idempotency_key) = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_key is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_order.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order cannot be fulfilled from status %', v_order.status;
    END IF;

    SELECT id
      INTO v_existing_id
      FROM fulfillment_orders
     WHERE site_id = v_order.store_id
       AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     LIMIT 1;

    IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'order', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id),
            'fulfillment_order_id', v_existing_id,
            'idempotent_replay', true
        );
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO fulfillment_orders (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        location_id,
        status,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        assigned_at,
        picked_at,
        packed_at,
        shipped_at,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        p_order_id,
        p_location_id,
        'in_progress',
        p_idempotency_key,
        p_request_id,
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        NOW(),
        CASE WHEN p_tracking_number IS NOT NULL THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'create_order_fulfillment'),
        p_actor_id
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_fulfillment_id;

    IF p_lines IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_lines) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p_lines) > 0 THEN
        FOR v_line IN
            SELECT *
            FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_lines) AS x(order_item_id UUID, quantity INTEGER)
        LOOP
            SELECT *
              INTO v_item
              FROM order_items
             WHERE id = v_line.order_item_id
               AND order_id = p_order_id
               AND deleted_at IS NULL
             FOR UPDATE;

            IF NOT FOUND THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'order item % not found', v_line.order_item_id;
            END IF;

            v_quantity := COALESCE(v_line.quantity, 0);
            v_remaining := v_item.quantity - COALESCE(v_item.fulfilled_quantity, 0);

            IF v_quantity <= 0 OR v_quantity > v_remaining THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid fulfillment quantity for order item %', v_item.id;
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO fulfillment_order_lines (
                site_id,
                fulfillment_order_id,
                order_id,
                order_item_id,
                product_id,
                variant_id,
                quantity,
                fulfilled_quantity,
                status,
                created_by
            )
            VALUES (
                v_order.store_id,
                v_fulfillment_id,
                p_order_id,
                v_item.id,
                v_item.product_id,
                NULLIF(v_item.variant_id, '')::uuid,
                v_quantity,
                v_quantity,
                CASE WHEN p_tracking_number IS NOT NULL THEN 'shipped' ELSE 'packed' END,
                p_actor_id
            );

            UPDATE order_items
               SET fulfilled_quantity = COALESCE(fulfilled_quantity, 0) + v_quantity,
                   fulfillment_status = CASE
                       WHEN COALESCE(fulfilled_quantity, 0) + v_quantity >= quantity THEN 'fulfilled'
                       ELSE 'partial'
                   END,
                   updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE id = v_item.id;

            v_line_count := v_line_count + 1;
        END LOOP;
    ELSE
        FOR v_item IN
            SELECT *
              FROM order_items
             WHERE order_id = p_order_id
               AND deleted_at IS NULL
             FOR UPDATE
        LOOP
            v_quantity := v_item.quantity - COALESCE(v_item.fulfilled_quantity, 0);
            IF v_quantity <= 0 THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO fulfillment_order_lines (
                site_id,
                fulfillment_order_id,
                order_id,
                order_item_id,
                product_id,
                variant_id,
                quantity,
                fulfilled_quantity,
                status,
                created_by
            )
            VALUES (
                v_order.store_id,
                v_fulfillment_id,
                p_order_id,
                v_item.id,
                v_item.product_id,
                NULLIF(v_item.variant_id, '')::uuid,
                v_quantity,
                v_quantity,
                CASE WHEN p_tracking_number IS NOT NULL THEN 'shipped' ELSE 'packed' END,
                p_actor_id
            );

            UPDATE order_items
               SET fulfilled_quantity = COALESCE(fulfilled_quantity, 0) + v_quantity,
                   fulfillment_status = 'fulfilled',
                   updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE id = v_item.id;

            v_line_count := v_line_count + 1;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    IF v_line_count = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'no fulfillable order lines remain';
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE(bool_and(COALESCE(fulfilled_quantity, 0) >= quantity), FALSE)
      INTO v_all_fulfilled
      FROM order_items
     WHERE order_id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    UPDATE fulfillment_orders
       SET status = CASE WHEN v_all_fulfilled THEN 'fulfilled' ELSE 'partially_fulfilled' END,
           shipped_at = CASE WHEN p_tracking_number IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(shipped_at, NOW()) ELSE shipped_at END,
           updated_by = p_actor_id,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_fulfillment_id;

    IF p_tracking_number IS NOT NULL OR p_carrier IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO shipments (
            site_id,
            order_id,
            fulfillment_order_id,
            status,
            carrier,
            tracking_number,
            tracking_url,
            shipped_at,
            idempotency_key,
            request_id,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            v_order.store_id,
            p_order_id,
            v_fulfillment_id,
            'shipped',
            p_carrier,
            p_tracking_number,
            p_tracking_url,
            NOW(),
            p_idempotency_key || ':shipment',
            p_request_id,
            p_actor_id
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_shipment_id;

        INSERT INTO shipment_events (
            site_id,
            shipment_id,
            order_id,
            event_type,
            status,
            description,
            request_id,
            metadata,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            v_order.store_id,
            v_shipment_id,
            p_order_id,
            'shipped',
            'shipped',
            'Shipment marked as shipped',
            p_request_id,
            jsonb_build_object('carrier', p_carrier, 'tracking_number', p_tracking_number),
            p_actor_id
        );
    END IF;

    UPDATE orders
       SET status = CASE WHEN p_tracking_number IS NOT NULL OR p_carrier IS NOT NULL THEN 'shipped' ELSE 'processing' END,
           fulfillment_status = CASE WHEN v_all_fulfilled THEN 'fulfilled' ELSE 'partial' END,
           tracking_number = COALESCE(p_tracking_number, tracking_number),
           carrier = COALESCE(p_carrier, carrier),
           updated_at = NOW(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE id = p_order_id;

    IF v_all_fulfilled THEN
        UPDATE inventory_reservations
           SET status = 'fulfilled',
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE order_id = p_order_id
           AND status = 'committed'
           AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        site_id,
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        trace_id,
        schema_version,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        v_order.store_id,
        'fulfillment_order',
        v_fulfillment_id::TEXT,
        'fulfillment.shipped',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'site_id', v_order.store_id,
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'fulfillment_order_id', v_fulfillment_id,
            'shipment_id', v_shipment_id,
            'all_fulfilled', v_all_fulfilled
        ),
        'fulfillment.shipped:' || v_fulfillment_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        p_request_id,
        1,
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'order', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id),
        'fulfillment_order_id', v_fulfillment_id,
        'shipment_id', v_shipment_id,
        'all_fulfilled', v_all_fulfilled
    );
END;
