procedures.prosrc:
DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_existing_return_id UUID;
    v_return_id UUID;
    v_refund_id UUID;
    v_refund_transaction_id UUID;
    v_payment_transaction_id UUID;
    v_line RECORD;
    v_item RECORD;
    v_quantity INTEGER;
    v_restock_quantity INTEGER;
    v_returnable INTEGER;
    v_refund_amount NUMERIC(12,2);
    v_total_refund NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_return_line_id UUID;
    v_level_id UUID;
    v_location_id UUID;
    v_new_available integer;
BEGIN
    IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_idempotency_key) = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_key is required';
    END IF;

    IF p_refund_method NOT IN ('original_payment', 'gift_card', 'manual') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported refund method: %', p_refund_method;
    END IF;

    SELECT *
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    IF v_order.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order cannot be returned from status %', v_order.status;
    END IF;

    SELECT id
      INTO v_existing_return_id
      FROM returns
     WHERE site_id = v_order.store_id
       AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     LIMIT 1;

    IF v_existing_return_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'order', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id),
            'return_id', v_existing_return_id,
            'idempotent_replay', true
        );
    END IF;

    SELECT id
      INTO v_payment_transaction_id
      FROM payment_transactions
     WHERE order_id = p_order_id
       AND site_id = v_order.store_id
       AND status IN ('captured', 'completed', 'partially_refunded')
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY captured_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC
     LIMIT 1;

    INSERT INTO returns (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        status,
        customer_email,
        reason,
        refund_method,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        authorized_at,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        p_order_id,
        'approved',
        v_order.customer_email,
        p_reason,
        p_refund_method,
        p_idempotency_key,
        p_request_id,
        NOW(),
        jsonb_build_object('restock_requested', p_restock),
        p_actor_id
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_return_id;

    IF p_lines IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_lines) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p_lines) > 0 THEN
        FOR v_line IN
            SELECT *
            FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_lines) AS x(order_item_id UUID, quantity INTEGER, restock_quantity INTEGER)
        LOOP
            SELECT *
              INTO v_item
              FROM order_items
             WHERE id = v_line.order_item_id
               AND order_id = p_order_id
               AND deleted_at IS NULL
             FOR UPDATE;

            IF NOT FOUND THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'order item % not found', v_line.order_item_id;
            END IF;

            v_quantity := COALESCE(v_line.quantity, 0);
            v_returnable := GREATEST(COALESCE(v_item.fulfilled_quantity, 0), v_item.quantity) - COALESCE(v_item.returned_quantity, 0);

            IF v_quantity <= 0 OR v_quantity > v_returnable THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid return quantity for order item %', v_item.id;
            END IF;

            v_refund_amount := ROUND(COALESCE(v_item.unit_price, 0) * v_quantity, 2);
            v_total_refund := v_total_refund + v_refund_amount;
            v_restock_quantity := CASE
                WHEN p_restock THEN LEAST(COALESCE(v_line.restock_quantity, v_quantity), v_quantity)
                ELSE 0
            END;

            INSERT INTO return_lines (
                site_id,
                return_id,
                order_id,
                order_item_id,
                product_id,
                variant_id,
                quantity,
                received_quantity,
                restock_quantity,
                refund_amount,
                reason,
                status,
                created_by
            )
            VALUES (
                v_order.store_id,
                v_return_id,
                p_order_id,
                v_item.id,
                v_item.product_id,
                v_item.variant_id,
                v_quantity,
                v_restock_quantity,
                v_restock_quantity,
                v_refund_amount,
                p_reason,
                CASE WHEN p_restock THEN 'restocked' ELSE 'authorized' END,
                p_actor_id
            )
            RETURNING id INTO v_return_line_id;

            UPDATE order_items
               SET returned_quantity = COALESCE(returned_quantity, 0) + v_quantity,
                   refunded_quantity = COALESCE(refunded_quantity, 0) + v_quantity,
                   fulfillment_status = CASE
                       WHEN COALESCE(returned_quantity, 0) + v_quantity >= quantity THEN 'returned'
                       ELSE fulfillment_status
                   END,
                   updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE id = v_item.id;

            IF v_restock_quantity > 0 THEN
                SELECT il.id, il.location_id
                  INTO v_level_id, v_location_id
                  FROM inventory_levels il
                  JOIN inventory_locations loc ON loc.id = il.location_id
                 WHERE il.product_id = v_item.product_id
                   AND ((v_item.variant_id IS NULL AND il.variant_id IS NULL) OR il.variant_id = v_item.variant_id)
                   AND loc.store_id = v_order.store_id
                   AND loc.status = 'active'
                   AND loc.deleted_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY loc.is_default DESC, il.updated_at ASC
                 LIMIT 1
                 FOR UPDATE OF il;

                IF v_level_id IS NOT NULL THEN
                    UPDATE inventory_levels
                       SET available = available + v_restock_quantity,
                           available_quantity = COALESCE(available_quantity, available) + v_restock_quantity,
                           on_hand_quantity = COALESCE(on_hand_quantity, available + reserved) + v_restock_quantity,
                           updated_at = NOW()
                     WHERE id = v_level_id
                     RETURNING available INTO v_new_available;

                    -- T17: a restocked return must move the shopper-visible cache too.
                    IF v_item.variant_id IS NULL THEN
                        UPDATE products SET stock = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = v_item.product_id;
                    ELSE
                        UPDATE product_variants SET inventory_qty = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = v_item.variant_id;
                    END IF;

                    INSERT INTO restock_events (
                        site_id,
                        return_id,
                        return_line_id,
                        inventory_level_id,
                        location_id,
                        product_id,
                        variant_id,
                        order_id,
                        quantity,
                        status,
                        idempotency_key,
                        request_id,
                        metadata,
                        created_by
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        v_order.store_id,
                        v_return_id,
                        v_return_line_id,
                        v_level_id,
                        v_location_id,
                        v_item.product_id,
                        v_item.variant_id,
                        p_order_id,
                        v_restock_quantity,
                        'committed',
                        'restock.return:' || v_return_line_id::TEXT,
                        p_request_id,
                        jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason),
                        p_actor_id
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

                    INSERT INTO inventory_events (
                        site_id,
                        inventory_level_id,
                        location_id,
                        product_id,
                        variant_id,
                        order_id,
                        event_type,
                        quantity_delta,
                        on_hand_quantity,
                        available_quantity,
                        committed_quantity,
                        unavailable_quantity,
                        incoming_quantity,
                        reserved_quantity,
                        safety_stock_quantity,
                        source_type,
                        source_id,
                        idempotency_key,
                        request_id,
                        metadata,
                        created_by
                    )
                    SELECT
                        v_order.store_id,
                        il.id,
                        il.location_id,
                        v_item.product_id,
                        v_item.variant_id,
                        p_order_id,
                        'return_restocked',
                        v_restock_quantity,
                        COALESCE(il.on_hand_quantity, il.available + il.reserved),
                        COALESCE(il.available_quantity, il.available),
                        COALESCE(il.committed_quantity, 0),
                        COALESCE(il.unavailable_quantity, 0),
                        COALESCE(il.incoming_quantity, il.incoming),
                        COALESCE(il.reserved_quantity, il.reserved),
                        COALESCE(il.safety_stock_quantity, 0),
                        'return',
                        v_return_id,
                        'inventory.return_restocked:' || v_return_line_id::TEXT,
                        p_request_id,
                        jsonb_build_object('return_id', v_return_id, 'return_line_id', v_return_line_id),
                        p_actor_id
                    FROM inventory_levels il
                    WHERE il.id = v_level_id
                    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    ELSE
        FOR v_item IN
            SELECT *
              FROM order_items
             WHERE order_id = p_order_id
               AND deleted_at IS NULL
             FOR UPDATE
        LOOP
            v_quantity := GREATEST(COALESCE(v_item.fulfilled_quantity, 0), v_item.quantity) - COALESCE(v_item.returned_quantity, 0);
            IF v_quantity <= 0 THEN
                CONTINUE;
            END IF;

            v_refund_amount := ROUND(COALESCE(v_item.unit_price, 0) * v_quantity, 2);
            v_total_refund := v_total_refund + v_refund_amount;
            v_restock_quantity := CASE WHEN p_restock THEN v_quantity ELSE 0 END;

            INSERT INTO return_lines (
                site_id,
                return_id,
                order_id,
                order_item_id,
                product_id,
                variant_id,
                quantity,
                received_quantity,
                restock_quantity,
                refund_amount,
                reason,
                status,
                created_by
            )
            VALUES (
                v_order.store_id,
                v_return_id,
                p_order_id,
                v_item.id,
                v_item.product_id,
                v_item.variant_id,
                v_quantity,
                v_restock_quantity,
                v_restock_quantity,
                v_refund_amount,
                p_reason,
                CASE WHEN p_restock THEN 'restocked' ELSE 'authorized' END,
                p_actor_id
            )
            RETURNING id INTO v_return_line_id;

            UPDATE order_items
               SET returned_quantity = COALESCE(returned_quantity, 0) + v_quantity,
                   refunded_quantity = COALESCE(refunded_quantity, 0) + v_quantity,
                   fulfillment_status = 'returned',
                   updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE id = v_item.id;

            IF v_restock_quantity > 0 THEN
                SELECT il.id, il.location_id
                  INTO v_level_id, v_location_id
                  FROM inventory_levels il
                  JOIN inventory_locations loc ON loc.id = il.location_id
                 WHERE il.product_id = v_item.product_id
                   AND ((v_item.variant_id IS NULL AND il.variant_id IS NULL) OR il.variant_id = v_item.variant_id)
                   AND loc.store_id = v_order.store_id
                   AND loc.status = 'active'
                   AND loc.deleted_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY loc.is_default DESC, il.updated_at ASC
                 LIMIT 1
                 FOR UPDATE OF il;

                IF v_level_id IS NOT NULL THEN
                    UPDATE inventory_levels
                       SET available = available + v_restock_quantity,
                           available_quantity = COALESCE(available_quantity, available) + v_restock_quantity,
                           on_hand_quantity = COALESCE(on_hand_quantity, available + reserved) + v_restock_quantity,
                           updated_at = NOW()
                     WHERE id = v_level_id
                     RETURNING available INTO v_new_available;

                    -- T17: a restocked return must move the shopper-visible cache too.
                    IF v_item.variant_id IS NULL THEN
                        UPDATE products SET stock = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = v_item.product_id;
                    ELSE
                        UPDATE product_variants SET inventory_qty = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = v_item.variant_id;
                    END IF;

                    INSERT INTO restock_events (
                        site_id,
                        return_id,
                        return_line_id,
                        inventory_level_id,
                        location_id,
                        product_id,
                        variant_id,
                        order_id,
                        quantity,
                        status,
                        idempotency_key,
                        request_id,
                        metadata,
                        created_by
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        v_order.store_id,
                        v_return_id,
                        v_return_line_id,
                        v_level_id,
                        v_location_id,
                        v_item.product_id,
                        v_item.variant_id,
                        p_order_id,
                        v_restock_quantity,
                        'committed',
                        'restock.return:' || v_return_line_id::TEXT,
                        p_request_id,
                        jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason),
                        p_actor_id
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

                    INSERT INTO inventory_events (
                        site_id,
                        inventory_level_id,
                        location_id,
                        product_id,
                        variant_id,
                        order_id,
                        event_type,
                        quantity_delta,
                        on_hand_quantity,
                        available_quantity,
                        committed_quantity,
                        unavailable_quantity,
                        incoming_quantity,
                        reserved_quantity,
                        safety_stock_quantity,
                        source_type,
                        source_id,
                        idempotency_key,
                        request_id,
                        metadata,
                        created_by
                    )
                    SELECT
                        v_order.store_id,
                        il.id,
                        il.location_id,
                        v_item.product_id,
                        v_item.variant_id,
                        p_order_id,
                        'return_restocked',
                        v_restock_quantity,
                        COALESCE(il.on_hand_quantity, il.available + il.reserved),
                        COALESCE(il.available_quantity, il.available),
                        COALESCE(il.committed_quantity, 0),
                        COALESCE(il.unavailable_quantity, 0),
                        COALESCE(il.incoming_quantity, il.incoming),
                        COALESCE(il.reserved_quantity, il.reserved),
                        COALESCE(il.safety_stock_quantity, 0),
                        'return',
                        v_return_id,
                        'inventory.return_restocked:' || v_return_line_id::TEXT,
                        p_request_id,
                        jsonb_build_object('return_id', v_return_id, 'return_line_id', v_return_line_id),
                        p_actor_id
                    FROM inventory_levels il
                    WHERE il.id = v_level_id
                    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
                END IF;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    IF v_total_refund <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'no refundable amount remains';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO refunds (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        return_id,
        payment_transaction_id,
        amount,
        currency,
        status,
        refund_method,
        provider,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        reason,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        p_order_id,
        v_return_id,
        v_payment_transaction_id,
        v_total_refund,
        COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
        'pending',
        p_refund_method,
        COALESCE(v_order.payment_gateway, v_order.payment_method),
        p_idempotency_key || ':refund',
        p_request_id,
        p_reason,
        jsonb_build_object('restock_requested', p_restock),
        p_actor_id
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_refund_id;

    INSERT INTO refund_lines (
        site_id,
        refund_id,
        return_line_id,
        order_item_id,
        amount,
        quantity,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        v_order.store_id,
        v_refund_id,
        rl.id,
        rl.order_item_id,
        rl.refund_amount,
        rl.quantity,
        p_actor_id
    FROM return_lines rl
    WHERE rl.return_id = v_return_id
      AND rl.deleted_at IS NULL;

    INSERT INTO refund_transactions (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        payment_transaction_id,
        amount,
        currency,
        status,
        refund_method,
        reason,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        p_order_id,
        v_payment_transaction_id,
        v_total_refund,
        COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
        'pending',
        p_refund_method,
        p_reason,
        p_idempotency_key || ':refund_transaction',
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object('return_id', v_return_id, 'refund_id', v_refund_id),
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id INTO v_refund_transaction_id;

    UPDATE returns
       SET metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('refund_id', v_refund_id, 'refund_transaction_id', v_refund_transaction_id),
           updated_at = NOW(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE id = v_return_id;

    UPDATE orders
       SET return_status = 'authorized',
           refund_status = 'pending',
           updated_at = NOW(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE id = p_order_id;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        site_id,
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        trace_id,
        schema_version,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        v_order.store_id,
        'refund',
        v_refund_id::TEXT,
        'refund.requested',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'site_id', v_order.store_id,
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'return_id', v_return_id,
            'refund_id', v_refund_id,
            'amount', v_total_refund,
            'refund_method', p_refund_method
        ),
        'refund.requested:' || v_refund_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        p_request_id,
        1,
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'order', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM orders o WHERE o.id = p_order_id),
        'return_id', v_return_id,
        'refund_id', v_refund_id,
        'refund_transaction_id', v_refund_transaction_id,
        'amount', v_total_refund,
        'status', 'pending'
    );
END;

DECLARE
    v_level_id UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT id
      INTO v_level_id
      FROM inventory_levels
     WHERE product_id = p_product_id
       AND ((p_variant_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL) OR variant_id = p_variant_id)
       AND location_id = p_location_id
     ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
     LIMIT 1
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_level_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO inventory_levels (
            product_id,
            variant_id,
            location_id,
            available,
            reserved,
            incoming,
            on_hand_quantity,
            available_quantity,
            incoming_quantity,
            reserved_quantity
        )
        VALUES (
            p_product_id,
            p_variant_id,
            p_location_id,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_level_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_level_id;
END;

DECLARE
    v_code TEXT := UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_code, '')));
    v_promo RECORD;
    v_min_order NUMERIC(12,2);
    v_customer_count INTEGER;
    v_global_count INTEGER;
    v_discount NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
BEGIN
    IF v_code = '' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'discount', 0);
    END IF;

    SELECT
        p.id AS promotion_id,
        pc.id AS promotion_code_id,
        NULL::UUID AS coupon_id,
        pc.code_normalized AS code,
        p.usage_limit AS promotion_usage_limit,
        p.per_customer_limit,
        pc.usage_limit AS code_usage_limit,
        pc.usage_count AS code_usage_count,
        pe.effect_type,
        pe.value,
        pe.max_discount,
        p.title
      INTO v_promo
      FROM promotion_codes pc
      JOIN promotions p ON p.id = pc.promotion_id
      JOIN promotion_effects pe ON pe.promotion_id = p.id AND pe.deleted_at IS NULL
     WHERE pc.site_id = p_store_id
       AND pc.code_normalized = v_code
       AND pc.status = 'active'
       AND p.status = 'active'
       AND pc.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND (pc.starts_at IS NULL OR pc.starts_at <= NOW())
       AND (pc.ends_at IS NULL OR pc.ends_at >= NOW())
       AND (p.starts_at IS NULL OR p.starts_at <= NOW())
       AND (p.ends_at IS NULL OR p.ends_at >= NOW())
     ORDER BY p.priority ASC, pe.created_at ASC
     LIMIT 1
     FOR UPDATE OF pc;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        SELECT
            NULL::UUID AS promotion_id,
            NULL::UUID AS promotion_code_id,
            c.id AS coupon_id,
            UPPER(c.code) AS code,
            c.usage_limit AS promotion_usage_limit,
            COALESCE(c.per_customer_limit, c.per_user_limit, 1) AS per_customer_limit,
            c.usage_limit AS code_usage_limit,
            COALESCE(c.usage_count, 0) AS code_usage_count,
            COALESCE(c.type, c.discount_type) AS effect_type,
            COALESCE(c.value, c.discount_value, 0) AS value,
            COALESCE(c.maximum_discount, c.max_discount) AS max_discount,
            COALESCE(c.description, c.code) AS title
          INTO v_promo
          FROM coupons c
         WHERE c.store_id = p_store_id
           AND UPPER(c.code) = v_code
           AND COALESCE(c.is_active, true) = true
           AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND (c.starts_at IS NULL OR c.starts_at <= NOW())
           AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at >= NOW())
         LIMIT 1
         FOR UPDATE;
    END IF;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'promotion code is invalid or inactive';
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE((pr.value ->> 'amount')::NUMERIC, 0)
      INTO v_min_order
      FROM promotion_rules pr
     WHERE pr.promotion_id = v_promo.promotion_id
       AND pr.rule_type = 'min_order_amount'
       AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY pr.created_at ASC
     LIMIT 1;

    IF v_min_order IS NULL AND v_promo.coupon_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT COALESCE(c.minimum_order_amount, c.min_order_amount)
          INTO v_min_order
          FROM coupons c
         WHERE c.id = v_promo.coupon_id;
    END IF;

    IF v_min_order IS NOT NULL AND p_subtotal < v_min_order THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'minimum order amount % required for promotion', v_min_order;
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO v_global_count
      FROM promotion_redemptions pr
     WHERE pr.site_id = p_store_id
       AND pr.status IN ('reserved', 'committed')
       AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND (
           (v_promo.promotion_id IS NOT NULL AND pr.promotion_id = v_promo.promotion_id)
           OR (v_promo.coupon_id IS NOT NULL AND pr.coupon_id = v_promo.coupon_id)
       );

    IF v_promo.promotion_usage_limit IS NOT NULL AND v_global_count >= v_promo.promotion_usage_limit THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'promotion usage limit reached';
    END IF;

    IF v_promo.code_usage_limit IS NOT NULL AND v_promo.code_usage_count >= v_promo.code_usage_limit THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'promotion code usage limit reached';
    END IF;

    IF p_customer_email IS NOT NULL AND v_promo.per_customer_limit IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
          INTO v_customer_count
          FROM promotion_redemptions pr
         WHERE pr.site_id = p_store_id
           AND LOWER(pr.customer_email) = LOWER(p_customer_email)
           AND pr.status IN ('reserved', 'committed')
           AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND (
               (v_promo.promotion_id IS NOT NULL AND pr.promotion_id = v_promo.promotion_id)
               OR (v_promo.coupon_id IS NOT NULL AND pr.coupon_id = v_promo.coupon_id)
           );

        IF v_customer_count >= v_promo.per_customer_limit THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'promotion customer usage limit reached';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF v_promo.effect_type = 'percentage' THEN
        v_discount := ROUND((p_subtotal * v_promo.value / 100.0), 2);
        IF v_promo.max_discount IS NOT NULL THEN
            v_discount := LEAST(v_discount, v_promo.max_discount);
        END IF;
    ELSIF v_promo.effect_type = 'fixed' THEN
        v_discount := v_promo.value;
    ELSIF v_promo.effect_type = 'free_shipping' THEN
        v_discount := p_shipping_amount;
    ELSE
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported promotion effect: %', v_promo.effect_type;
    END IF;

    v_discount := LEAST(GREATEST(v_discount, 0), p_subtotal + p_shipping_amount);

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'valid', true,
        'discount', v_discount,
        'code', v_promo.code,
        'promotion_id', v_promo.promotion_id,
        'promotion_code_id', v_promo.promotion_code_id,
        'coupon_id', v_promo.coupon_id,
        'effect_type', v_promo.effect_type,
        'title', v_promo.title
    );
END;

DECLARE
    v_event outbox_events;
    v_next_status TEXT;
    v_retry_seconds INTEGER;
BEGIN
    SELECT *
      INTO v_event
      FROM outbox_events
     WHERE id = p_event_id
       AND status = 'processing'
       AND locked_by = p_dispatcher_id
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_event.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox event % is not claimable by dispatcher %', p_event_id, p_dispatcher_id;
    END IF;

    v_next_status := CASE WHEN v_event.attempts >= v_event.max_attempts THEN 'dead' ELSE 'failed' END;
    v_retry_seconds := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_retry_seconds, 60), 10), 3600);

    IF v_next_status = 'dead' THEN
        INSERT INTO outbox_dead_letters (
            site_id, outbox_event_id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id,
            payload, failure_reason, attempts, request_id, trace_id, idempotency_key,
            schema_version, metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            COALESCE(v_event.site_id, v_event.store_id),
            v_event.id,
            v_event.event_id,
            v_event.event_type,
            v_event.aggregate_type,
            v_event.aggregate_id,
            v_event.payload,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_error_message, ''), 'Unknown dispatcher failure'),
            v_event.attempts,
            v_event.request_id,
            v_event.trace_id,
            v_event.idempotency_key,
            v_event.schema_version,
            COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
        )
        ON CONFLICT (outbox_event_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            failure_reason = EXCLUDED.failure_reason,
            attempts = EXCLUDED.attempts,
            metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
            updated_at = NOW(),
            deleted_at = NULL;
    END IF;

    UPDATE outbox_events
       SET status = v_next_status,
           locked_at = NULL,
           locked_by = NULL,
           available_at = CASE
               WHEN v_next_status = 'dead' THEN available_at
               ELSE NOW() + make_interval(secs => v_retry_seconds)
           END,
           next_attempt_at = CASE
               WHEN v_next_status = 'dead' THEN next_attempt_at
               ELSE NOW() + make_interval(secs => v_retry_seconds)
           END,
           error_message = LEFT(COALESCE(p_error_message, 'Dispatcher failure'), 2000),
           dead_lettered_at = CASE WHEN v_next_status = 'dead' THEN NOW() ELSE dead_lettered_at END,
           dead_letter_reason = CASE WHEN v_next_status = 'dead' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(p_error_message, 'Dispatcher failure'), 2000) ELSE dead_letter_reason END,
           dispatch_metadata = dispatch_metadata || COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::JSONB),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_event.id
     RETURNING * INTO v_event;

    RETURN v_event;
END;

DECLARE
    updated_message distributed_queue_messages%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    UPDATE distributed_queue_messages
       SET leased_until = NOW() + make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(p_visibility_seconds, 120), 1)),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE message_id = p_message_id
       AND leased_by = p_worker_id
       AND fencing_token = p_fencing_token
       AND status = 'leased'
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
    RETURNING * INTO updated_message;

    IF updated_message.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'queue lease heartbeat rejected for message %', p_message_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO distributed_queue_heartbeats (
        message_id,
        queue_name,
        worker_id,
        fencing_token,
        leased_until,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        updated_message.message_id,
        updated_message.queue_name,
        p_worker_id,
        p_fencing_token,
        updated_message.leased_until,
        jsonb_build_object('heartbeat_source', 'queue-runtime')
    );

    RETURN updated_message;
END;

DECLARE
    v_rollup analytics_rollups_daily;
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO analytics_rollups_daily (
        site_id, metric_name, rollup_date, dimensions, metric_value
    )
    VALUES (
        p_site_id,
        p_metric_name,
        p_rollup_date,
        COALESCE(p_dimensions, '{}'::JSONB),
        COALESCE(p_increment, 1)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, metric_name, rollup_date, dimensions)
    DO UPDATE SET
        metric_value = analytics_rollups_daily.metric_value + EXCLUDED.metric_value,
        updated_at = NOW(),
        deleted_at = NULL
    RETURNING * INTO v_rollup;

    RETURN v_rollup;
END;

DECLARE
    v_next_version INTEGER;
    v_release_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();
    v_published_at TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW();
    v_theme_instance_id UUID;
    v_theme_package_version_id UUID;
    v_schema_manifest_version TEXT := '1.0.0';
    v_cache_manifest JSONB;
    v_release_manifest JSONB;
BEGIN
    IF p_store_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'store_id is required';
    END IF;

    IF p_theme_id IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(p_theme_id)) = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'theme_id is required';
    END IF;

    -- Match the canonical draft writer's site-first lock order before release numbering.
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.sites WHERE id=p_store_id FOR UPDATE;

    SELECT
        ti.id,
        ti.theme_package_version_id,
        COALESCE(tpv.schema_version, '1.0.0')
      INTO v_theme_instance_id, v_theme_package_version_id, v_schema_manifest_version
      FROM theme_instances ti
      LEFT JOIN theme_package_versions tpv ON tpv.id = ti.theme_package_version_id
     WHERE ti.store_id = p_store_id
       AND ti.theme_slug = p_theme_id
       AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY
       CASE WHEN ti.instance_status = 'active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
       ti.updated_at DESC
     LIMIT 1;

    v_schema_manifest_version := COALESCE(v_schema_manifest_version, '1.0.0');

    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(tr.release_version), 0) + 1
      INTO v_next_version
      FROM theme_releases tr
     WHERE tr.store_id = p_store_id
       AND tr.deleted_at IS NULL;

    v_cache_manifest := jsonb_build_object(
        'tags',
        jsonb_build_array(
            'store:' || p_store_id::TEXT,
            'theme:' || p_theme_id,
            'theme_release:' || v_release_id::TEXT
        )
    );

    v_release_manifest := jsonb_build_object(
        'engine',
        'theme-engine-v1',
        'store_id',
        p_store_id,
        'theme_id',
        p_theme_id,
        'release_id',
        v_release_id,
        'release_version',
        v_next_version,
        'theme_instance_id',
        v_theme_instance_id,
        'theme_package_version_id',
        v_theme_package_version_id,
        'schema_manifest_version',
        v_schema_manifest_version
    );

    UPDATE theme_releases
       SET is_current = FALSE,
           release_status = 'superseded',
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE store_id = p_store_id
       AND is_current = TRUE
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    INSERT INTO theme_releases (
        id,
        store_id,
        theme_id,
        theme_instance_id,
        theme_package_version_id,
        release_version,
        release_status,
        is_current,
        release_config,
        release_manifest,
        template_snapshot,
        settings_snapshot,
        asset_manifest,
        cache_manifest,
        data_binding_manifest,
        schema_manifest_version,
        engine_version,
        source_draft_id,
        source_draft_version,
        publish_message,
        published_by,
        rollback_of_release_id,
        metadata,
        published_at
    )
    VALUES (
        v_release_id,
        p_store_id,
        p_theme_id,
        v_theme_instance_id,
        v_theme_package_version_id,
        v_next_version,
        'published',
        TRUE,
        COALESCE(p_release_config, '{}'::JSONB),
        v_release_manifest,
        COALESCE(p_release_config, '{}'::JSONB),
        COALESCE(p_release_config->'themeSettings', '{}'::JSONB),
        '{}'::JSONB,
        v_cache_manifest,
        '{}'::JSONB,
        v_schema_manifest_version,
        'theme-engine-v1',
        p_source_draft_id,
        p_source_draft_version,
        p_publish_message,
        p_published_by,
        p_rollback_of_release_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'request_id', p_request_id,
            'source', CASE WHEN p_rollback_of_release_id IS NULL THEN 'publish' ELSE 'rollback' END
        ),
        v_published_at
    );

    UPDATE sites
       SET theme_id = p_theme_id,
           template_config = COALESCE(p_release_config, '{}'::JSONB),
           current_theme_release_id = v_release_id,
           storefront_release_version = v_next_version,
           status = CASE WHEN p_make_store_live THEN 'published' ELSE status END,
           published = CASE WHEN p_make_store_live THEN true ELSE sites.published END,
           published_at = CASE WHEN p_make_store_live THEN v_published_at ELSE sites.published_at END,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = p_store_id;

    IF v_theme_instance_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF p_make_store_live THEN
            -- Retire the previous instance before satisfying the one-active index.
            -- The site lock and publisher transaction cover both sides of the switch.
            UPDATE theme_instances SET instance_status = 'inactive', updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = p_published_by
             WHERE store_id = p_store_id AND id <> v_theme_instance_id
               AND instance_status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL;
            UPDATE store_themes SET is_active = (theme_id = (SELECT id FROM themes WHERE slug = p_theme_id)), updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE store_id = p_store_id;
        END IF;
        UPDATE theme_instances
           SET active_release_id = v_release_id,
               instance_status = CASE WHEN p_make_store_live THEN 'active' ELSE instance_status END,
               activated_at = CASE WHEN p_make_store_live THEN v_published_at ELSE activated_at END,
               updated_at = NOW(),
               updated_by = p_published_by
         WHERE id = v_theme_instance_id;

    END IF;

    INSERT INTO storefront_cache_tags (
        store_id,
        tag,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        release_id,
        invalidated_at
    )
    VALUES
        (p_store_id, 'store:' || p_store_id::TEXT, 'store', p_store_id::TEXT, v_release_id, NOW()),
        (p_store_id, 'theme:' || p_theme_id, 'theme', p_theme_id, v_release_id, NOW()),
        (p_store_id, 'theme_release:' || v_release_id::TEXT, 'theme_release', v_release_id::TEXT, v_release_id, NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (store_id, tag)
    DO UPDATE SET
        resource_type = EXCLUDED.resource_type,
        resource_id = EXCLUDED.resource_id,
        release_id = EXCLUDED.release_id,
        invalidated_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW();

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        p_store_id,
        'theme_release',
        v_release_id::TEXT,
        CASE WHEN p_rollback_of_release_id IS NULL THEN 'theme.release.published' ELSE 'theme.release.rollback_published' END,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'store_id', p_store_id,
            'theme_id', p_theme_id,
            'theme_instance_id', v_theme_instance_id,
            'theme_package_version_id', v_theme_package_version_id,
            'release_id', v_release_id,
            'release_version', v_next_version,
            'cache_tags', v_cache_manifest->'tags'
        ),
        'theme.release:' || p_store_id::TEXT || ':' || v_next_version::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        p_published_by
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO audit_activity_events (
        store_id,
        actor_id,
        actor_type,
        action,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        request_id,
        after_state,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        p_store_id,
        p_published_by,
        'user',
        CASE WHEN p_rollback_of_release_id IS NULL THEN 'theme.publish' ELSE 'theme.rollback' END,
        'theme_release',
        v_release_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'theme_id', p_theme_id,
            'theme_instance_id', v_theme_instance_id,
            'theme_package_version_id', v_theme_package_version_id,
            'release_id', v_release_id,
            'release_version', v_next_version
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
            'publish_message', p_publish_message,
            'rollback_of_release_id', p_rollback_of_release_id
        )
    );

    release_id := v_release_id;
    release_version := v_next_version;
    published_at := v_published_at;
    RETURN NEXT;
END;

DECLARE
    v_source_level_id UUID;
    v_dest_level_id UUID;
    v_new_available integer;
BEGIN
    v_source_level_id := ensure_inventory_level_for_location(p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id, p_transfer.source_location_id);
    v_dest_level_id := ensure_inventory_level_for_location(p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id, p_transfer.destination_location_id);

    UPDATE inventory_transfer_lines
       SET quantity_received = quantity_received + p_quantity,
           status = CASE WHEN quantity_received + p_quantity >= quantity_requested THEN 'received' ELSE 'partially_received' END,
           updated_at = NOW(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE id = p_line.id;

    UPDATE inventory_levels
       SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - p_quantity, 0),
           reserved_quantity = GREATEST(COALESCE(reserved_quantity, reserved) - p_quantity, 0),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_source_level_id;

    UPDATE inventory_levels
       SET available = available + p_quantity,
           available_quantity = COALESCE(available_quantity, available) + p_quantity,
           on_hand_quantity = COALESCE(on_hand_quantity, available + reserved) + p_quantity,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_dest_level_id
     RETURNING available INTO v_new_available;

    -- T17: the destination location just received stock -- sync the cache to its new total.
    IF p_line.variant_id IS NULL THEN
        UPDATE products SET stock = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_line.product_id;
    ELSE
        UPDATE product_variants SET inventory_qty = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_line.variant_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO inventory_transfer_receipts (
        site_id, transfer_id, transfer_line_id, product_id, variant_id,
        source_location_id, destination_location_id, quantity_received,
        idempotency_key, request_id, created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_transfer.site_id, p_transfer.id, p_line.id, p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id,
        p_transfer.source_location_id, p_transfer.destination_location_id, p_quantity,
        p_idempotency_key || ':line:' || p_line.id::TEXT, p_request_id, p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO inventory_events (
        site_id, inventory_level_id, location_id, product_id, variant_id,
        event_type, quantity_delta, on_hand_quantity, available_quantity,
        committed_quantity, unavailable_quantity, incoming_quantity, reserved_quantity,
        safety_stock_quantity, source_type, source_id, idempotency_key, request_id, metadata, created_by
    )
    SELECT
        p_transfer.site_id, il.id, p_transfer.destination_location_id, p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id,
        'transfer_received', p_quantity, COALESCE(il.on_hand_quantity, il.available + il.reserved),
        COALESCE(il.available_quantity, il.available), COALESCE(il.committed_quantity, 0),
        COALESCE(il.unavailable_quantity, 0), COALESCE(il.incoming_quantity, il.incoming),
        COALESCE(il.reserved_quantity, il.reserved), COALESCE(il.safety_stock_quantity, 0),
        'inventory_transfer', p_transfer.id, 'inventory.transfer_received:' || p_line.id::TEXT || ':' || p_idempotency_key,
        p_request_id, jsonb_build_object('quantity_received', p_quantity), p_actor_id
    FROM inventory_levels il WHERE il.id = v_dest_level_id
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

DECLARE
    v_level_id UUID;
    v_new_available integer;
BEGIN
    v_level_id := ensure_inventory_level_for_location(p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id, p_line.location_id);

    UPDATE purchase_order_lines
       SET quantity_received = quantity_received + p_quantity,
           status = CASE WHEN quantity_received + p_quantity >= quantity_ordered THEN 'received' ELSE 'partially_received' END,
           updated_at = NOW(),
           updated_by = p_actor_id
     WHERE id = p_line.id;

    UPDATE inventory_levels
       SET available = available + p_quantity,
           incoming = GREATEST(incoming - p_quantity, 0),
           available_quantity = COALESCE(available_quantity, available) + p_quantity,
           incoming_quantity = GREATEST(COALESCE(incoming_quantity, incoming) - p_quantity, 0),
           on_hand_quantity = COALESCE(on_hand_quantity, available + reserved) + p_quantity,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_level_id
     RETURNING available INTO v_new_available;

    -- T17: a PO receipt increases on-hand stock -- sync the cache to its new total.
    IF p_line.variant_id IS NULL THEN
        UPDATE products SET stock = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_line.product_id;
    ELSE
        UPDATE product_variants SET inventory_qty = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_line.variant_id;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO purchase_order_receipts (
        site_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_line_id, product_id, variant_id, location_id,
        quantity_received, idempotency_key, request_id, created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_po.site_id, p_po.id, p_line.id, p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id, p_line.location_id,
        p_quantity, p_idempotency_key || ':line:' || p_line.id::TEXT, p_request_id, p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO inventory_events (
        site_id, inventory_level_id, location_id, product_id, variant_id,
        event_type, quantity_delta, on_hand_quantity, available_quantity,
        committed_quantity, unavailable_quantity, incoming_quantity, reserved_quantity,
        safety_stock_quantity, source_type, source_id, idempotency_key, request_id, metadata, created_by
    )
    SELECT
        p_po.site_id, il.id, p_line.location_id, p_line.product_id, p_line.variant_id,
        'po_received', p_quantity, COALESCE(il.on_hand_quantity, il.available + il.reserved),
        COALESCE(il.available_quantity, il.available), COALESCE(il.committed_quantity, 0),
        COALESCE(il.unavailable_quantity, 0), COALESCE(il.incoming_quantity, il.incoming),
        COALESCE(il.reserved_quantity, il.reserved), COALESCE(il.safety_stock_quantity, 0),
        'purchase_order', p_po.id, 'inventory.po_received:' || p_line.id::TEXT || ':' || p_idempotency_key,
        p_request_id, jsonb_build_object('quantity_received', p_quantity), p_actor_id
    FROM inventory_levels il WHERE il.id = v_level_id
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
END;

DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_event_id TEXT;
    v_order_json JSONB;
BEGIN
    IF p_order_id IS NULL OR p_provider IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_id and provider are required';
    END IF;

    IF p_payment_status NOT IN ('failed', 'refunded') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported payment status';
    END IF;

    IF p_order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported order status';
    END IF;

    v_event_id := COALESCE(
        NULLIF(p_provider_event_id, ''),
        p_provider || ':' || p_payment_status || ':' || p_order_id::TEXT
    );

    SELECT id, store_id, payment_status, status
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO payment_webhook_events (
        provider,
        provider_event_id,
        event_type,
        signature_valid,
        processing_status,
        raw_payload,
        processed_at
    )
    VALUES (
        p_provider,
        v_event_id,
        'checkout.payment.' || p_payment_status,
        TRUE,
        'processed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'provider', p_provider,
            'payment_status', p_payment_status,
            'order_status', p_order_status,
            'reason', p_reason,
            'request_id', p_request_id
        ),
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        signature_valid = TRUE,
        processing_status = 'processed',
        processed_at = COALESCE(payment_webhook_events.processed_at, NOW()),
        updated_at = NOW();

    UPDATE orders
       SET payment_status = p_payment_status,
           status = p_order_status,
           payment_failure_reason = p_reason,
           last_payment_event_id = v_event_id,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = p_order_id
     RETURNING to_jsonb(orders.*) INTO v_order_json;

    IF p_release_inventory THEN
        PERFORM release_order_inventory(p_order_id, NULL, p_request_id, COALESCE(p_reason, 'payment_failed'));
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        'order',
        p_order_id::TEXT,
        'payment.' || p_payment_status,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'store_id', v_order.store_id,
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'provider', p_provider,
            'provider_event_id', v_event_id,
            'payment_status', p_payment_status,
            'order_status', p_order_status,
            'reason', p_reason
        ),
        'payment.' || p_payment_status || ':' || p_provider || ':' || v_event_id,
        p_request_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO audit_activity_events (
        store_id,
        actor_type,
        action,
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        request_id,
        after_state
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        'webhook',
        'payment.' || p_payment_status,
        'order',
        p_order_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'order_id', p_order_id,
            'provider', p_provider,
            'provider_event_id', v_event_id,
            'payment_status', p_payment_status,
            'order_status', p_order_status,
            'reason', p_reason
        )
    );

    RETURN v_order_json;
END;

DECLARE
  v_order_json jsonb;
  v_order record;
  v_payment_transaction_id uuid;
  v_attempt_status text := CASE WHEN p_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 'succeeded' ELSE 'failed' END;
  v_site_id uuid;
  v_amount_minor bigint;
  v_ledger_transaction_id uuid;
  v_ledger_idempotency_key text;
BEGIN
  v_order_json := record_order_payment_failure(
    p_order_id,
    p_provider,
    p_provider_event_id,
    p_payment_status,
    p_order_status,
    p_reason,
    p_release_inventory,
    p_request_id
  );

  SELECT *
    INTO v_order
    FROM orders
   WHERE id = p_order_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
  END IF;

  v_site_id := COALESCE(v_order.site_id, v_order.store_id);
  v_amount_minor := round(COALESCE(v_order.total, 0) * 100)::bigint;
  v_ledger_idempotency_key := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_idempotency_key, ''), NULLIF(p_provider_event_id, ''), p_order_id::text);

  UPDATE payment_transactions
     SET status = CASE WHEN p_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 'refunded' ELSE 'failed' END,
         provider_event_id = p_provider_event_id,
         failure_reason = p_reason,
         refunded_at = CASE WHEN p_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN COALESCE(refunded_at, now()) ELSE refunded_at END,
         request_id = COALESCE(p_request_id, request_id),
         idempotency_key = COALESCE(v_ledger_idempotency_key, idempotency_key),
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE order_id = p_order_id
     AND gateway = p_provider
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;

  IF v_payment_transaction_id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO payment_transactions (
      order_id,
      store_id,
      site_id,
      gateway,
      amount,
      currency,
      status,
      failure_reason,
      provider_event_id,
      payment_method,
      metadata,
      request_id,
      idempotency_key,
      refunded_at
    )
    VALUES (
      p_order_id,
      v_order.store_id,
      v_site_id,
      p_provider,
      COALESCE(v_order.total, 0),
      COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
      CASE WHEN p_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN 'refunded' ELSE 'failed' END,
      p_reason,
      p_provider_event_id,
      p_provider,
      jsonb_build_object('source', 'payment_failure'),
      p_request_id,
      v_ledger_idempotency_key,
      CASE WHEN p_payment_status = 'refunded' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;
  END IF;

  IF p_payment_status = 'refunded' AND v_amount_minor > 0 THEN
    v_ledger_transaction_id := public.post_settlement_ledger_transaction(
      v_site_id,
      'refund',
      'payment-failure:' || p_order_id::text || ':' || COALESCE(p_provider_event_id, v_ledger_idempotency_key),
      v_ledger_idempotency_key,
      jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code', 'merchant_payable',
          'side', 'debit',
          'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
          'memo', 'Payment failure refund merchant payable reversal ' || p_order_id::text
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code', 'refund_clearing',
          'side', 'credit',
          'amount_minor', v_amount_minor,
          'memo', 'Payment failure refund clearing ' || p_order_id::text
        )
      ),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'compatibility_table', 'payment_transactions',
        'payment_transaction_id', v_payment_transaction_id,
        'order_id', p_order_id,
        'provider', p_provider,
        'provider_event_id', p_provider_event_id
      ),
      p_request_id
    );

    UPDATE payment_transactions
       SET metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
         || jsonb_build_object('canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = v_payment_transaction_id;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO payment_attempts (
    site_id,
    order_id,
    payment_transaction_id,
    provider,
    attempt_type,
    status,
    amount,
    currency,
    provider_event_id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_id,
    failure_reason,
    metadata
  )
  VALUES (
    v_site_id,
    p_order_id,
    v_payment_transaction_id,
    p_provider,
    'failure',
    v_attempt_status,
    COALESCE(v_order.total, 0),
    COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
    p_provider_event_id,
    v_ledger_idempotency_key,
    p_request_id,
    p_reason,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'payment_status', p_payment_status,
      'order_status', p_order_status,
      'canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id
    )
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  RETURN v_order_json || jsonb_build_object('canonical_ledger_transaction_id', v_ledger_transaction_id);
END;

DECLARE
    recovered_count INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
    WITH candidates AS (
        SELECT id
          FROM distributed_queue_messages
         WHERE queue_name = p_queue_name
           AND status = 'leased'
           AND leased_until <= NOW()
           AND deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY leased_until ASC
         LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 100), 1), 500)
         FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    ),
    recovered AS (
        UPDATE distributed_queue_messages AS message
           SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'dead-lettered' ELSE 'retrying' END,
               available_at = NOW(),
               leased_until = NULL,
               leased_by = NULL,
               error_message = COALESCE(error_message, p_reason),
               updated_at = NOW()
          FROM candidates
         WHERE message.id = candidates.id
        RETURNING message.message_id
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO recovered_count FROM recovered;

    INSERT INTO queue_recovery_operations (
        operation_id,
        queue_name,
        operation,
        message_ids,
        reason,
        status,
        result
    )
    VALUES (
        p_recovery_operation_id,
        p_queue_name,
        'release-expired-lease',
        ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
        p_reason,
        'completed',
        jsonb_build_object('recovered_count', recovered_count)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (operation_id) DO UPDATE
       SET status = EXCLUDED.status,
           result = EXCLUDED.result,
           updated_at = NOW();

    RETURN recovered_count;
END;

DECLARE
    redriven_count INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
    WITH redriven AS (
        UPDATE distributed_queue_messages
           SET status = 'retrying',
               available_at = NOW(),
               leased_until = NULL,
               leased_by = NULL,
               error_message = NULL,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE queue_name = p_queue_name
           AND status = 'dead-lettered'
           AND deleted_at IS NULL
           AND (
                COALESCE(array_length(p_message_ids, 1), 0) = 0
                OR message_id = ANY(p_message_ids)
           )
        RETURNING message_id
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO redriven_count FROM redriven;

    INSERT INTO queue_recovery_operations (
        operation_id,
        queue_name,
        operation,
        message_ids,
        reason,
        status,
        result
    )
    VALUES (
        p_recovery_operation_id,

        'redrive',
        COALESCE(p_message_ids, ARRAY[]::TEXT[]),
        p_reason,
        'completed',
        jsonb_build_object('redriven_count', redriven_count)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (operation_id) DO UPDATE
       SET status = EXCLUDED.status,
           result = EXCLUDED.result,
           updated_at = NOW();

    RETURN redriven_count;
END;

DECLARE
    v_order RECORD;
    v_item RECORD;
    v_level_id UUID;
    v_new_available integer;
BEGIN
    SELECT id, store_id
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM inventory_reservations
        WHERE order_id = p_order_id
          AND status = 'released'
          AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ) THEN
        RETURN TRUE;
    END IF;

    FOR v_item IN
        SELECT product_id, NULLIF(variant_id, '')::uuid AS variant_id, quantity
          FROM order_items
         WHERE order_id = p_order_id
           AND deleted_at IS NULL
    LOOP
        SELECT il.id
          INTO v_level_id
          FROM inventory_levels il
          JOIN inventory_locations loc ON loc.id = il.location_id
         WHERE il.product_id = v_item.product_id
           AND (
                (v_item.variant_id IS NULL AND il.variant_id IS NULL)
                OR il.variant_id = v_item.variant_id
           )
           AND loc.store_id = v_order.store_id
           AND loc.status = 'active'
           AND loc.deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY loc.is_default DESC, il.updated_at ASC
         LIMIT 1
         FOR UPDATE OF il;

        IF FOUND THEN
            UPDATE inventory_levels
               SET available = available + v_item.quantity,
                   updated_at = NOW()
             WHERE id = v_level_id
             RETURNING available INTO v_new_available;

            -- T17: order cancellation restores stock -- the shopper-visible cache must move too.
            IF v_item.variant_id IS NULL THEN
                UPDATE products SET stock = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = v_item.product_id;
            ELSE
                UPDATE product_variants SET inventory_qty = v_new_available, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = v_item.variant_id;
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO inventory_adjustments (
                product_id,
                variant_id,
                location_id,
                quantity_change,
                reason,
                reference_id,
                note,
                created_by
            )
            SELECT
                v_item.product_id,
                v_item.variant_id,
                location_id,
                v_item.quantity,
                'return',
                p_order_id,
                p_release_reason,
                p_actor_id
            FROM inventory_levels
            WHERE id = v_level_id;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    -- CAP-C47: a released commitment is no longer committed.
    --
    -- commit_inventory_reservation adds v_reservation.quantity to the level's committed_quantity and
    -- NOTHING has ever subtracted it -- not this function, not expire_unpaid_committed_reservations,
    -- not release_order_inventory_with_ledger (whose single mention of the column is a name in an
    -- inventory_events INSERT). So the column only grew, and the figure apps/merchant_app shows the
    -- merchant as "committed" drifted upward without bound. No oversell risk: reserve_inventory gates
    -- on `available`, which this function already restores correctly.
    --
    -- Driven by the order's status='committed' RESERVATIONS, deliberately not by the order_items loop
    -- above. That loop restores `available` per item and knows nothing about whether a commit ever
    -- happened -- an order cancelled while merely reserved never incremented committed_quantity, and
    -- subtracting its item quantities would corrupt the column in the opposite direction. This
    -- subtracts exactly what the commit added, grouped per level in case one level backs several
    -- reservations. GREATEST(0, ...) is a floor for rows committed before the column was maintained.
    UPDATE inventory_levels il
       SET committed_quantity = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(il.committed_quantity, 0) - committed.total_quantity),
           updated_at = NOW()
      FROM (
            SELECT location_id, product_id, variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
              FROM inventory_reservations
             WHERE order_id = p_order_id
               AND status = 'committed'
               AND deleted_at IS NULL
             GROUP BY location_id, product_id, variant_id
      ) AS committed
     WHERE il.location_id = committed.location_id
       AND il.product_id = committed.product_id
       AND (
            (committed.variant_id IS NULL AND il.variant_id IS NULL)
            OR il.variant_id = committed.variant_id
       );

    UPDATE inventory_reservations
       SET status = 'released',
           released_at = NOW(),
           release_reason = p_release_reason,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE order_id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    UPDATE orders
       SET inventory_released_at = NOW(),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = p_order_id;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order.store_id,
        'order',
        p_order_id::TEXT,
        'inventory.released',
        jsonb_build_object('store_id', v_order.store_id, 'order_id', p_order_id),
        'inventory.released:' || p_order_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN TRUE;
END;

DECLARE
    v_released BOOLEAN;
    v_site_id UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT store_id
      INTO v_site_id
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF v_site_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'order not found';
    END IF;

    v_released := release_order_inventory(
        p_order_id,
        p_actor_id,
        p_request_id,
        p_release_reason
    );

    INSERT INTO inventory_events (
        site_id,
        inventory_level_id,
        location_id,
        product_id,
        variant_id,
        order_id,
        reservation_id,
        event_type,
        quantity_delta,
        on_hand_quantity,
        available_quantity,
        committed_quantity,
        unavailable_quantity,
        incoming_quantity,
        reserved_quantity,
        safety_stock_quantity,
        source_type,
        source_id,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        v_site_id,
        il.id,
        r.location_id,
        oi.product_id,
        NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '')::uuid,
        p_order_id,
        r.id,
        'sale_released',
        oi.quantity,
        COALESCE(il.on_hand_quantity, il.available + il.reserved),
        COALESCE(il.available_quantity, il.available),
        0,
        COALESCE(il.unavailable_quantity, 0),
        COALESCE(il.incoming_quantity, il.incoming),
        COALESCE(il.reserved_quantity, il.reserved),
        COALESCE(il.safety_stock_quantity, 0),
        'order',
        p_order_id,
        'inventory.sale_released:' || p_order_id::TEXT || ':' || oi.id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object('release_reason', p_release_reason),
        p_actor_id
      FROM order_items oi
      LEFT JOIN inventory_reservations r
        ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
       AND r.product_id = oi.product_id
       AND (
           (r.variant_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '') IS NULL)
           OR r.variant_id = NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '')::uuid
       )
      LEFT JOIN inventory_levels il
        ON il.location_id = r.location_id
       AND il.product_id = oi.product_id
       AND (
           (il.variant_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '') IS NULL)
           OR il.variant_id = NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '')::uuid
       )
     WHERE oi.order_id = p_order_id
       AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN v_released;
END;

DECLARE
    v_dead outbox_dead_letters;
    v_event outbox_events;
BEGIN
    SELECT *
      INTO v_dead
      FROM outbox_dead_letters
     WHERE id = p_dead_letter_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_dead.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'dead letter % not found', p_dead_letter_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE outbox_events
       SET status = 'queued',
           attempts = 0,
           locked_at = NULL,
           locked_by = NULL,
           available_at = NOW(),
           next_attempt_at = NOW(),
           error_message = NULL,
           dead_lettered_at = NULL,
           dead_letter_reason = NULL,
           request_id = COALESCE(p_request_id, request_id),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_dead.outbox_event_id
     RETURNING * INTO v_event;

    UPDATE outbox_dead_letters
       SET replayed_at = NOW(),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_dead.id;

    RETURN v_event;
END;

DECLARE
    updated_message distributed_queue_messages%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    UPDATE distributed_queue_messages
       SET status = 'retrying',
           available_at = COALESCE(p_available_at, NOW()),
           leased_until = NULL,
           error_message = p_error_message,
           result = COALESCE(p_result, '{}'),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE message_id = p_message_id
       AND leased_by = p_worker_id
       AND fencing_token = p_fencing_token
       AND status = 'leased'
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
    RETURNING * INTO updated_message;

    IF updated_message.id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'queue retry rejected for message %', p_message_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN updated_message;
END;

DECLARE
    replay runtime_replay_executions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO runtime_replay_executions (
        replay_id,
        owner_runtime,
        site_id,
        event_types,
        cursor,
        status,
        dry_run,
        requested_by,
        reason
    )
    VALUES (
        p_replay_id,
        p_owner_runtime,
        p_site_id,
        COALESCE(p_event_types, ARRAY[]::TEXT[]),
        COALESCE(p_cursor, '{}'),
        'planned',
        COALESCE(p_dry_run, TRUE),
        p_requested_by,
        p_reason
    )
    ON CONFLICT (replay_id) DO UPDATE
       SET cursor = EXCLUDED.cursor,
           event_types = EXCLUDED.event_types,
           dry_run = EXCLUDED.dry_run,
           reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
           updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING * INTO replay;

    INSERT INTO replay_operation_schedules (
        replay_id,
        owner_runtime,
        site_id,
        event_types,
        cursor,
        batch_size,
        dry_run,
        requested_by,
        status,
        request_id,
        correlation_id,
        trace_id
    )
    VALUES (
        p_replay_id,
        p_owner_runtime,
        p_site_id,
        COALESCE(p_event_types, ARRAY[]::TEXT[]),
        COALESCE(p_cursor, '{}'),
        LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_batch_size, 100), 1), 1000),
        COALESCE(p_dry_run, TRUE),
        p_requested_by,
        'planned',
        p_request_id,
        p_correlation_id,
        p_trace_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (replay_id) DO UPDATE
       SET cursor = EXCLUDED.cursor,
           batch_size = EXCLUDED.batch_size,
           dry_run = EXCLUDED.dry_run,
           request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id,
           correlation_id = EXCLUDED.correlation_id,
           trace_id = EXCLUDED.trace_id,
           updated_at = NOW();

DECLARE
    checked_count INTEGER;
    min_position BIGINT;
    max_position BIGINT;
    gap_count INTEGER;
    duplicate_count INTEGER;
    check_status TEXT;
    check_row event_store_integrity_checks%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER, MIN(stream_position), MAX(stream_position)
      INTO checked_count, min_position, max_position
      FROM (
          SELECT stream_position
            FROM distributed_event_store
           WHERE stream_name = p_stream_name
             AND deleted_at IS NULL
           ORDER BY stream_position DESC
           LIMIT p_limit
      ) recent;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
      INTO duplicate_count
      FROM (
          SELECT stream_position
            FROM distributed_event_store
           WHERE stream_name = p_stream_name
             AND deleted_at IS NULL
           GROUP BY stream_position
          HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
      ) duplicates;

    gap_count := CASE
        WHEN checked_count = 0 OR min_position IS NULL OR max_position IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST((max_position - min_position + 1 - checked_count)::INTEGER, 0)
    END;

    check_status := CASE WHEN gap_count = 0 AND duplicate_count = 0 THEN 'passed' ELSE 'failed' END;

    INSERT INTO event_store_integrity_checks (
        check_id,
        stream_name,
        environment,
        status,
        checked_events,
        min_stream_position,
        max_stream_position,
        gap_count,
        duplicate_count,
        result
    )
    VALUES (
        'event-store-' || p_stream_name || '-' || extract(epoch from now())::BIGINT,
        p_stream_name,
        p_environment,
        check_status,
        checked_count,
        min_position,
        max_position,
        gap_count,
        duplicate_count,
        jsonb_build_object('limit', p_limit)
    )
    RETURNING * INTO check_row;

    RETURN check_row;
END;

DECLARE
    v_divergent_count integer := 0;
    v_missing_relational_count integer := 0;
    v_stale_jsonb_count integer := 0;
    v_sample jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_status text;
    v_report public.dual_model_reconciliation_reports;
BEGIN
    WITH order_counts AS (
        SELECT
            orders.id,
            orders.order_number,
            CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(orders.items) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(orders.items)
                ELSE 0
            END AS jsonb_count,
            count(order_items.id)::integer AS relational_count
        FROM public.orders
        LEFT JOIN public.order_items
          ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
         AND order_items.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE orders.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY orders.id, orders.order_number, orders.items
    ),
    divergent AS (
        SELECT *
          FROM order_counts
         WHERE jsonb_count <> relational_count
    )
    SELECT
        count(*)::integer,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_count > 0 AND relational_count = 0)::integer,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE relational_count > 0 AND jsonb_count <> relational_count)::integer
      INTO v_divergent_count, v_missing_relational_count, v_stale_jsonb_count
      FROM divergent;

    WITH order_counts AS (
        SELECT
            orders.id,
            orders.order_number,
            CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(orders.items) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(orders.items)
                ELSE 0
            END AS jsonb_count,
            count(order_items.id)::integer AS relational_count
        FROM public.orders
        LEFT JOIN public.order_items
          ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
         AND order_items.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE orders.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY orders.id, orders.order_number, orders.items
    ),
    divergent AS (
        SELECT *
          FROM order_counts
         WHERE jsonb_count <> relational_count
    )
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id', id,
        'order_number', order_number,
        'jsonb_count', jsonb_count,
        'relational_count', relational_count
    ) ORDER BY order_number) FILTER (WHERE id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
      INTO v_sample
      FROM (
        SELECT *
          FROM divergent
         ORDER BY order_number
         LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_sample_limit, 25), 1), 100)
      ) sample_rows;

    v_status := CASE WHEN v_divergent_count = 0 THEN 'clean' ELSE 'divergent' END;

    v_report := public.record_dual_model_reconciliation_report(
        'orders_items',
        'orders.items',
        'order_items',
        'report',
        v_status,
        v_divergent_count,
        v_missing_relational_count,
        v_stale_jsonb_count,
        true,
        false,
        v_sample,
        'Dry-run report. order_items is authoritative after reader cutover; use reconcile_orders_items_dual_model(false) only in an approved staging/prod data window.'
    );

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'report_id', v_report.id,
        'status', v_status,
        'divergent_count', v_divergent_count,
        'missing_relational_count', v_missing_relational_count,
        'stale_jsonb_count', v_stale_jsonb_count,
        'sample', v_sample
    );
END;

DECLARE
    v_rows integer := 0;
BEGIN
    WITH target_orders AS (
        SELECT orders.id, orders.items
          FROM public.orders
         WHERE orders.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND jsonb_typeof(orders.items) = 'array'
           AND jsonb_array_length(orders.items) > 0
           AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                  FROM public.order_items
                 WHERE order_items.order_id = orders.id
                   AND order_items.deleted_at IS NULL
           )
         ORDER BY orders.created_at ASC
         LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 500), 1), 5000)
    ),
    inserted AS (
        INSERT INTO public.order_items (
            order_id,
            product_id,
            variant_id,
            name,
            title,
            sku,
            quantity,
            price,
            unit_price,
            total,
            product_snapshot,
            created_at,
            updated_at
        )
        SELECT
            target_orders.id,
            CASE
                WHEN legacy_item.value->>'product_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
                    THEN (legacy_item.value->>'product_id')::uuid
                ELSE NULL
            END,
            NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'variant_id', ''),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'name', ''), NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'title', ''), 'Item'),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'title', ''), NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'name', ''), 'Item'),
            NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'sku', ''),
            GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'quantity', '')::integer, 1), 1),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'price', '')::numeric, NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'unit_price', '')::numeric, 0),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'unit_price', '')::numeric, NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'price', '')::numeric, 0),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'total', '')::numeric, COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'price', '')::numeric, NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'unit_price', '')::numeric, 0) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(legacy_item.value->>'quantity', '')::integer, 1), 1)),
            CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(legacy_item.value->'product_snapshot') = 'object' THEN legacy_item.value->'product_snapshot'
                ELSE '{}'::jsonb
            END,
            now(),
            now()
          FROM target_orders
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(target_orders.items) WITH ORDINALITY AS legacy_item(value, ordinal)
        RETURNING 1
    )
    SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_rows FROM inserted;

    RETURN COALESCE(v_rows, 0);
END;

DECLARE
    v_rows integer := 0;
BEGIN
    WITH relational_payloads AS (
        SELECT

                'id', order_items.id,

                'variant_id', order_items.variant_id,

          FROM public.order_items
         WHERE order_items.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
    ledger_entries.site_id,
    ledger_entries.currency,
    SUM(CASE ledger_entries.side WHEN 'debit' THEN ledger_entries.amount_minor ELSE -ledger_entries.amount_minor END)::bigint AS break_minor
  FROM public.ledger_entries

DECLARE
  v_reservation public.inventory_reservations%ROWTYPE;
  v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR v_reservation IN
    SELECT *
      FROM public.inventory_reservations
     WHERE status IN ('active', 'hold')
       AND expires_at <= now()
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY expires_at ASC
     LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 100), 1), 1000)
     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.inventory_levels
       SET reserved = GREATEST(reserved - v_reservation.quantity, 0),
           reserved_quantity = GREATEST(COALESCE(reserved_quantity, reserved) - v_reservation.quantity, 0),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE store_id = v_reservation.store_id
       AND product_id = v_reservation.product_id
       AND variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_reservation.variant_id
       AND location_id = v_reservation.location_id;

    UPDATE public.inventory_reservations
       SET status = 'expired',
           released_at = now(),
           release_reason = 'ttl_expired',
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = v_reservation.id;

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_count;
END;
