DECLARE
  v_wallet_available_minor bigint;
  v_ledger_merchant_payable_minor bigint;
  v_variance_minor bigint;
  v_row public.money_ledger_site_reconciliations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE wallet_ledger_entries.direction
      WHEN 'credit' THEN wallet_ledger_entries.amount_minor_bigint
      ELSE -wallet_ledger_entries.amount_minor_bigint
    END
  ), 0)::bigint
    INTO v_wallet_available_minor
    FROM public.wallet_ledger_entries
   WHERE wallet_ledger_entries.site_id = p_site_id
     AND wallet_ledger_entries.status = 'posted'
     AND wallet_ledger_entries.deleted_at IS NULL;

  v_ledger_merchant_payable_minor := public.ledger_account_balance_minor(p_site_id, 'merchant_payable');
  v_variance_minor := v_ledger_merchant_payable_minor - v_wallet_available_minor;

  INSERT INTO public.money_ledger_site_reconciliations (
    site_id,
    status,
    wallet_available_minor,
    ledger_merchant_payable_minor,
    variance_minor,
    metadata,
    verified_at
  )
  VALUES (
    p_site_id,
    CASE WHEN v_variance_minor = 0 THEN 'verified' ELSE 'mismatch' END,
    v_wallet_available_minor,
    v_ledger_merchant_payable_minor,
    v_variance_minor,
    jsonb_build_object('source', 'foundation_wave_1_reconciliation'),
    CASE WHEN v_variance_minor = 0 THEN now() ELSE NULL END
  )
  ON CONFLICT (site_id) DO UPDATE
  SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    wallet_available_minor = EXCLUDED.wallet_available_minor,
    ledger_merchant_payable_minor = EXCLUDED.ledger_merchant_payable_minor,
    variance_minor = EXCLUDED.variance_minor,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    verified_at = EXCLUDED.verified_at,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO v_row;

  RETURN v_row;
END;

DECLARE
  v_entry public.cod_reconciliation_entries%ROWTYPE;
  v_replay public.cod_reconciliation_entries%ROWTYPE;
  v_deposited_amount_minor bigint;
  v_collected_amount_minor bigint;
  v_expected_amount_minor bigint;
  v_status text;
  v_ledger_transaction_id uuid;
  v_wallet_idempotency_key text;
BEGIN
  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR btrim(p_idempotency_key) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_key is required';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_replay
    FROM public.cod_reconciliation_entries
   WHERE site_id = p_site_id
     AND reconciliation_idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN v_replay;
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_entry
    FROM public.cod_reconciliation_entries
   WHERE id = p_entry_id
     AND site_id = p_site_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COD reconciliation entry not found';
  END IF;

  v_expected_amount_minor := COALESCE(v_entry.expected_amount_minor_bigint, v_entry.expected_amount_minor::bigint, 0);
  v_collected_amount_minor := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_entry.collected_amount_minor_bigint, 0), v_entry.expected_amount_minor_bigint, v_entry.expected_amount_minor::bigint, 0);
  v_deposited_amount_minor := COALESCE(p_deposited_amount_minor, v_collected_amount_minor);

  IF v_deposited_amount_minor < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'deposited_amount_minor must be non-negative';
  END IF;

  v_status := CASE
    WHEN v_deposited_amount_minor < v_expected_amount_minor THEN 'short'
    WHEN v_deposited_amount_minor > v_expected_amount_minor THEN 'over'
    ELSE 'reconciled'
  END;

  UPDATE public.cod_reconciliation_entries
     SET status = v_status,
         collected_amount_minor = LEAST(v_collected_amount_minor, 2147483647)::integer,
         collected_amount_minor_bigint = v_collected_amount_minor,
         deposited_amount_minor = LEAST(v_deposited_amount_minor, 2147483647)::integer,
         deposited_amount_minor_bigint = v_deposited_amount_minor,
         difference_amount_minor = GREATEST(LEAST(v_deposited_amount_minor - v_expected_amount_minor, 2147483647), -2147483648)::integer,
         difference_amount_minor_bigint = v_deposited_amount_minor - v_expected_amount_minor,
         deposited_at = COALESCE(deposited_at, now()),
         reconciled_at = now(),
         reconciliation_idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key,
         notes = COALESCE(p_notes, notes),
         metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
           || jsonb_build_object('reconciled_by', 'merchant_mobile'),
         updated_by = p_actor_id,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = v_entry.id
     AND site_id = v_entry.site_id
   RETURNING * INTO v_entry;

  IF v_deposited_amount_minor > 0 THEN
    v_ledger_transaction_id := public.post_settlement_ledger_transaction(
      v_entry.site_id,
      'cod_remittance',
      v_entry.id::text,
      'cod-remittance:' || v_entry.id::text || ':' || p_idempotency_key,
      jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code',
          'cod_receivable',
          'side',
          'debit',
          'amount_minor',
          v_deposited_amount_minor,
          'memo',
          'COD remittance received ' || v_entry.id::text
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
          'account_code',
          'merchant_payable',
          'side',
          'credit',
          'amount_minor',
          v_deposited_amount_minor,
          'memo',
          'Merchant payable COD remittance ' || v_entry.id::text
        )
      ),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'compatibility_table',
        'cod_reconciliation_entries',
        'cod_reconciliation_entry_id',
        v_entry.id,
        'order_id',
        v_entry.order_id,
        'expected_amount_minor',
        v_expected_amount_minor,
        'deposited_amount_minor',
        v_deposited_amount_minor,
        'difference_amount_minor',
        v_deposited_amount_minor - v_expected_amount_minor
      ),
      p_request_id
    );

    UPDATE public.cod_reconciliation_entries
       SET canonical_ledger_transaction_id = v_ledger_transaction_id,
           updated_by = p_actor_id,
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = v_entry.id
       AND site_id = v_entry.site_id
     RETURNING * INTO v_entry;

    v_wallet_idempotency_key := 'cod-remittance:' || v_entry.id::text || ':' || p_idempotency_key;
    INSERT INTO public.wallet_ledger_entries (
      site_id,
      entry_type,
      direction,
      status,
      currency,
      amount_minor,
      amount_minor_bigint,
      reference_type,
      reference_id,
      description,
      idempotency_key,
      canonical_ledger_transaction_id,
      metadata,
      created_by,
      updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
      v_entry.site_id,
      'cod_remittance_credit',
      'credit',
      'posted',
      COALESCE(v_entry.currency, 'INR'),
      LEAST(v_deposited_amount_minor, 2147483647)::integer,
      v_deposited_amount_minor,
      'cod_reconciliation_entry',
      v_entry.id::text,
      'COD remittance for order ' || v_entry.order_id::text,
      v_wallet_idempotency_key,
      v_ledger_transaction_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'order_id',
        v_entry.order_id,
        'difference_amount_minor',
        v_deposited_amount_minor - v_expected_amount_minor,
        'reconciliation_status',
        v_status,
        'compatibility_only',
        true
      ),
      p_actor_id,
      p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key)
    WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
    DO UPDATE SET
      canonical_ledger_transaction_id = EXCLUDED.canonical_ledger_transaction_id,
      amount_minor_bigint = EXCLUDED.amount_minor_bigint,
      updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by,
      updated_at = now();
  END IF;

  RETURN v_entry;
END;

DECLARE
  v_balance numeric(12,2);
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN entry_type IN ('issued', 'credit', 'refund_credit', 'release') THEN amount
        WHEN entry_type IN ('debit', 'hold', 'expire', 'fraud_hold') THEN -amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    (SELECT COALESCE(initial_value, balance, 0)
       FROM gift_card_accounts
      WHERE id = p_account_id AND site_id = p_site_id)
  )
  INTO v_balance
  FROM gift_card_ledger_entries
  WHERE gift_card_account_id = p_account_id
    AND site_id = p_site_id
    AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  RETURN GREATEST(COALESCE(v_balance, 0), 0);
END;

DECLARE
  v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT
      gca.id,
      gca.site_id AS store_id,
      gca.code_last4,
      gca.initial_value,
      public.gift_card_available_balance(gca.id, gca.site_id) AS balance,
      gca.currency,
      gca.status,
      gca.fraud_hold_reason,
      gca.expires_at,
      gca.created_at,
      gca.metadata->>'recipient_email' AS recipient_email,

    FROM gift_card_accounts gca
    WHERE gca.site_id = p_store_id
      AND gca.deleted_at IS NULL
  ) t;

  RETURN v_rows;
END;

DECLARE
  v_order_id uuid;
  v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  -- No require_inventory_site_guc call: like expire_inventory_reservations,
  -- this is a scheduled background sweep across every tenant, not a
  -- per-request tenant-scoped operation -- consistent with the existing
  -- sweeper's own design in this same function group.
  FOR v_order_id IN
    SELECT o.id
      FROM public.orders o
     WHERE o.payment_method <> 'cod'
       AND o.payment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'paid'
       AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
       AND o.inventory_released_at IS NULL
       AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
           FROM public.inventory_reservations r
          WHERE r.order_id = o.id
            AND r.status = 'committed'
            AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND r.committed_at IS NOT NULL
            AND r.committed_at <= now() - make_interval(
              secs => LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_grace_seconds, 1800), 60), 604800)
            )
       )
     ORDER BY o.id
     LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 100), 1), 1000)
     FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    -- release_order_inventory_with_ledger re-locks this same orders row
    -- FOR UPDATE internally -- a transaction re-acquiring its own row lock
    -- is safe in Postgres, not a deadlock.
    PERFORM public.release_order_inventory_with_ledger(
      v_order_id,
      NULL,
      p_request_id,
      'ttl_expired_unpaid'
    );
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_count;
END;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN entry_type IN ('earned', 'refund_credit', 'adjustment_credit') THEN points
      WHEN entry_type IN ('redeemed', 'expired', 'adjustment_debit') THEN -points
      ELSE 0
    END
  ), 0)::bigint
    FROM public.loyalty_ledger_entries
   WHERE loyalty_account_id = p_loyalty_account_id;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN entry_type IN ('purchased', 'granted', 'released') THEN amount_minor
      -- CHANGED BY 239: 'spent' is deliberately absent. Spend draws down a CAMPAIGN's allocation,
      -- which left this account when the 'allocated' entry was written. Subtracting it here too
      -- debits the same money twice. See this migration's header for the worked example.
      WHEN entry_type IN ('allocated', 'expired', 'revoked') THEN -amount_minor
      ELSE 0
    END
  ), 0)::bigint
    FROM public.ad_credit_ledger_entries
   WHERE ad_credit_account_id = p_ad_credit_account_id;

SELECT
    pl.campaign_id,
    pl.product_id,
    pl.site_id,
    pl.position,
    p.name,
    p.slug,
    p.price,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(to_jsonb(p.images)) = 'array'
         THEN to_jsonb(p.images) ->> 0 ELSE NULL END AS image_url
  FROM public.ad_campaign_placements pl
  JOIN public.ad_campaigns c
    ON c.id = pl.campaign_id AND c.site_id = pl.site_id
  JOIN public.products p
    ON p.id = pl.product_id AND p.site_id = pl.site_id
  JOIN public.channel_listings cl
    ON cl.product_id = p.id
   AND cl.site_id = pl.site_id
   AND cl.channel = 'marketplace'
   AND cl.status = 'approved'
   AND cl.visibility = 'public'
  JOIN public.sites s
    ON s.id = pl.site_id
 WHERE pl.is_active
   AND c.status = 'active'
   AND public.ad_campaign_remaining_minor(c.id) > 0
   AND (c.daily_budget_minor IS NULL
        OR public.ad_campaign_spent_today_minor(c.id, NULL) < c.daily_budget_minor)
   AND (c.starts_at IS NULL OR c.starts_at <= now())
   AND (c.ends_at IS NULL OR c.ends_at >= now())
   AND p.is_active
   AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND s.status = 'published'
   AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
 ORDER BY c.bid_minor DESC, pl.position ASC, pl.created_at ASC
 LIMIT GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 10), 20), 1);

procedures.prosrc:
DECLARE
    -- F-LOY-1: loyalty applied as TENDER. Named for what it is; the amount is subtracted from what
    -- is PAYABLE, never from the taxable total.
    v_loyalty_amount NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_loyalty_points_applied BIGINT := 0;
    v_loyalty_residual_minor BIGINT := 0;
    v_loyalty_max_points BIGINT := 0;
    v_loyalty_program public.loyalty_programs%ROWTYPE;
    v_loyalty_result JSONB;
    v_existing_order_id UUID;
    v_order_json JSONB;
    v_order_id UUID;
    v_purchase_id UUID;
    v_order RECORD;
    v_shipping_method TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_shipping_method), ''), 'standard');
    v_shipping_amount NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_tax_amount NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_discount_amount NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_gift_card_amount NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_gift_card_balance NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_grand_total NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_payment_due NUMERIC(12,2) := 0;
    v_promotion JSONB := jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'discount', 0);
    v_gift_card RECORD;
    v_payment_transaction_id UUID;
    v_rate_row RECORD;
    v_store_has_rates BOOLEAN := false;
    v_tax_line JSONB;
BEGIN
    IF p_store_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'store_id is required';
    END IF;

    IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR BTRIM(p_idempotency_key) = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_key is required';
    END IF;

    IF p_payment_method NOT IN ('razorpay', 'cod') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported payment method: %', p_payment_method;
    END IF;

    -- CHK-0: restored from migration 206 (Phase R3). Serialize concurrent callers sharing the
    -- same (site_id, idempotency_key) BEFORE the existence check below and before every row lock
    -- this function transitively takes. Advisory-FIRST is what prevents a deadlock against
    -- reserve_inventory's FOR UPDATE on inventory_levels and this function's own gift-card
    -- FOR UPDATE on gift_card_accounts. Transaction-scoped: released at COMMIT or ROLLBACK.
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_store_id::text || ':' || p_idempotency_key, 0));

    SELECT order_id
      INTO v_existing_order_id
      FROM checkout_sessions
     WHERE site_id = p_store_id
       AND idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     LIMIT 1;

    IF v_existing_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT to_jsonb(o)
          INTO v_order_json
          FROM orders o
         WHERE o.id = v_existing_order_id
           AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

        IF v_order_json IS NOT NULL THEN
            IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) i WHERE i ? 'cart_fact_ref')
              OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=v_existing_order_id AND oi.product_snapshot ? 'cart_line_id') THEN
              IF (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i->>'product_id',nullif(i->>'variant_id',''),(i->>'quantity')::integer,
                nullif(i->>'marketplace_listing_id',''),i->'cart_fact_ref'->>'cart_id',i->'cart_fact_ref'->>'line_id',
                i->'cart_fact_ref'->'product_version',i->'cart_fact_ref'->>'configuration_fingerprint',i->'cart_fact_ref'->>'snapshot_fingerprint')
                ORDER BY i->'cart_fact_ref'->>'line_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) i)
                IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(oi.product_id::text,nullif(oi.variant_id,''),oi.quantity,
                  oi.marketplace_listing_id::text,oi.product_snapshot->>'cart_id',oi.product_snapshot->>'cart_line_id',
                  oi.product_snapshot->'product_version',oi.product_snapshot->>'configuration_fingerprint',oi.product_snapshot->>'snapshot_fingerprint')
                  ORDER BY oi.product_snapshot->>'cart_line_id') FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=v_existing_order_id AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL) THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'CART_FACT_RECEIPT_CONFLICT'; END IF;
            END IF;
            RETURN v_order_json;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- (a) Shipping resolution: server-side rate lookup when the store has configured rates.
    SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
      INTO v_store_has_rates
      FROM public.shipping_rates sr
      JOIN public.shipping_zones sz ON sz.id = sr.zone_id
     WHERE sz.site_id = p_store_id
       AND sr.is_active = true
       AND sr.deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF v_store_has_rates AND p_shipping_rate_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- Resolve the specific rate; validate it belongs to this store and is active.
        SELECT sr.type, sr.price,
               sr.min_order_amount, sr.max_order_amount,
               sr.min_weight_grams, sr.max_weight_grams
          INTO v_rate_row
          FROM public.shipping_rates sr
          JOIN public.shipping_zones sz ON sz.id = sr.zone_id
         WHERE sr.id = p_shipping_rate_id
           AND sz.site_id = p_store_id
           AND sr.is_active = true
           AND sr.deleted_at IS NULL;

        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'shipping rate not found or does not belong to this store: %', p_shipping_rate_id;
        END IF;

        IF v_rate_row.type = 'free' THEN
            v_shipping_amount := 0;
        ELSE
            -- flat / price_based / weight_based: use the configured price column.
            -- Price/weight range checks are advisory (display-only) in V1; cost comes from price column.
            v_shipping_amount := COALESCE(v_rate_row.price, 0);
        END IF;

    ELSIF v_store_has_rates AND p_shipping_rate_id IS NULL THEN
        -- Store has rates but caller did not pass an ID — use legacy fallback.
        IF v_shipping_method = 'express' THEN
            v_shipping_amount := 99;
        ELSE
            v_shipping_amount := 0;
        END IF;

    ELSE
        -- No configured rates: legacy hardcoded fallback (express=99, standard=0).
        IF v_shipping_method = 'express' THEN
            v_shipping_amount := 99;
        ELSIF v_shipping_method = 'standard' THEN
            v_shipping_amount := 0;
        ELSE
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported shipping method: %', v_shipping_method;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    -- (b) GST: when the gateway has computed tax server-side, accept it; otherwise 0.
    v_tax_amount := COALESCE(p_tax_amount, 0);

    v_order_json := create_order_with_inventory_reservations(
        p_store_id,
        p_customer_name,
        p_customer_email,
        p_customer_phone,
        COALESCE(p_shipping_address, '{}'::JSONB),
        p_items,
        p_payment_method,
        p_notes,
        NULL,
        p_actor_id,
        p_request_id
    );

    v_order_id := (v_order_json ->> 'id')::UUID;

    SELECT *
      INTO v_order
      FROM orders
     WHERE id = v_order_id
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'created order not found';
    END IF;

    -- CHK-1 (D-3): every checkout gets a parent purchase with exactly one child order, so a
    -- multi-merchant cart later is a constraint change, not a second checkout code path. The
    -- parent deliberately holds no money and no status -- the child order remains the single
    -- source of truth for both (D-PURCHASE-TENANCY, decisions.md 2b). Same transaction as the
    -- order, and downstream of the advisory lock above, so a replayed idempotency key returns
    -- early and can never create a second parent.
    INSERT INTO public.purchases (
        origin_site_id,
        channel,
        customer_email,
        customer_name,
        customer_phone,
        currency,
        idempotency_key
    )
    VALUES (
        p_store_id,
        'storefront',
        p_customer_email,
        p_customer_name,
        p_customer_phone,
        COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
        p_idempotency_key
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_purchase_id;

    UPDATE orders
       SET purchase_id = v_purchase_id
     WHERE id = v_order_id;

    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_coupon_code, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_promotion := evaluate_checkout_promotion(
            p_store_id,
            p_coupon_code,
            COALESCE(v_order.subtotal, 0),
            v_shipping_amount,
            p_customer_email
        );
        v_discount_amount := COALESCE((v_promotion ->> 'discount')::NUMERIC, 0);
    END IF;

    -- T15/W2: GST is computed on v_grand_total BEFORE the gift card is even looked up below —
    -- a gift card is TENDER (a payment method), never a pre-tax discount. Confirmed correct as
    -- written: v_tax_amount (from p_tax_amount, computed server-side in the gateway before any
    -- gift-card consideration) is folded into v_grand_total here; the gift card only reduces
    -- v_payment_due afterward. No change needed for this ordering.
    v_grand_total := GREATEST(COALESCE(v_order.subtotal, 0) + v_shipping_amount + v_tax_amount - v_discount_amount, 0);

    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_gift_card_code, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT *
          INTO v_gift_card
          FROM gift_card_accounts gca
         WHERE gca.site_id = p_store_id
           AND gca.code_hash = encode(extensions.digest(p_gift_card_code, 'sha256'), 'hex')
           AND gca.status = 'active'
           AND gca.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND (gca.expires_at IS NULL OR gca.expires_at >= NOW())
         FOR UPDATE;

        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'gift card is invalid or unavailable';
        END IF;

        SELECT COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN entry_type IN ('issued', 'credit', 'refund_credit', 'release') THEN amount
                    WHEN entry_type IN ('debit', 'hold', 'expire', 'fraud_hold') THEN -amount
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            COALESCE(v_gift_card.initial_value, v_gift_card.balance, 0)
        )
          INTO v_gift_card_balance
          FROM gift_card_ledger_entries
         WHERE gift_card_account_id = v_gift_card.id
           AND site_id = p_store_id
           AND deleted_at IS NULL;

        v_gift_card_amount := LEAST(COALESCE(v_gift_card_balance, 0), v_grand_total);

        IF v_gift_card_amount <= 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'gift card has no redeemable balance';
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO gift_card_redemptions (
            site_id,
            gift_card_account_id,
            order_id,
            amount,
            status,
            idempotency_key,
            request_id,
            metadata,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            p_store_id,
            v_gift_card.id,
            v_order_id,
            v_gift_card_amount,
            'committed',
            'gift_card.redemption:' || v_order_id::TEXT || ':' || v_gift_card.id::TEXT,
            p_request_id,
            jsonb_build_object('code_last4', v_gift_card.code_last4),
            p_actor_id
        )
        ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

        INSERT INTO gift_card_ledger_entries (
            site_id,
            gift_card_account_id,
            order_id,
            entry_type,
            amount,
            balance_after,
            idempotency_key,
            request_id,
            metadata,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            p_store_id,
            v_gift_card.id,
            v_order_id,
            'debit',
            v_gift_card_amount,
            COALESCE(v_gift_card_balance, 0) - v_gift_card_amount,
            'gift_card.debit:' || v_order_id::TEXT || ':' || v_gift_card.id::TEXT,
            p_request_id,
            jsonb_build_object('code_last4', v_gift_card.code_last4),
            p_actor_id
        )
        ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    -- ── F-LOY-1: loyalty points as TENDER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Same rule as the gift card above (T15/W2): GST was computed on v_grand_total and is NOT
    -- touched here. Points reduce what is PAYABLE; they are not a pre-tax discount, so the invoice
    -- and the tax lines are identical whether or not points are used.
    --
    -- Applied AFTER the gift card, on what remains. A gift card is money the buyer already holds and
    -- carries no cap; loyalty is the merchant's marketing spend and does. Spending the buyer's own
    -- balance first means points are never burned on an amount a gift card would have covered.
    IF p_loyalty_points IS NOT NULL AND p_loyalty_points > 0 AND p_buyer_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT * INTO v_loyalty_program FROM public.loyalty_programs WHERE site_id = p_store_id;

        -- A store with no programme, or a paused one, simply applies no points. It is not an error:
        -- a buyer whose client offered points must not have their checkout fail because the merchant
        -- turned the programme off in between.
        IF FOUND AND v_loyalty_program.is_active THEN
            v_loyalty_residual_minor := GREATEST(ROUND((v_grand_total - v_gift_card_amount) * 100), 0)::BIGINT;

            -- REFUSE rather than silently apply fewer points. Probing showed the first version of
            -- this block clamped here while an over-request against the BALANCE raised inside
            -- redeem_loyalty_points — two different answers to the same situation, "the client asked
            -- for more than can be applied". Clamping is the worse of the two: the buyer is shown one
            -- figure by the client and charged another, because the points silently dropped out. One
            -- policy, and it is the explicit one — the caller re-reads the balance and the cap and
            -- offers again. Nothing is debited on this path, so there is no partial state to unwind.
            v_loyalty_max_points := FLOOR(v_loyalty_residual_minor / v_loyalty_program.point_value_minor)::BIGINT;
            IF p_loyalty_points > v_loyalty_max_points THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'loyalty points exceed what this order can apply: % requested, % applicable',
                    p_loyalty_points, v_loyalty_max_points;
            END IF;
            v_loyalty_points_applied := p_loyalty_points;

            IF v_loyalty_points_applied > 0 THEN
                -- The residual is passed as the authoritative payable amount (233): this function
                -- knows it exactly, whereas orders.total is mid-mutation here — it still holds the
                -- pre-adjustment figure and is not rewritten until the UPDATE below.
                --
                -- The idempotency key is DERIVED from the checkout's, mirroring the gift card's
                -- 'gift_card.redemption:' convention, so a replayed checkout cannot debit twice. The
                -- checkout's own replay check returns long before this point; this is the backstop.
                v_loyalty_result := public.redeem_loyalty_points(
                    p_store_id,
                    p_buyer_account_id,
                    v_order_id,
                    v_loyalty_points_applied,
                    'loyalty.redemption:' || v_order_id::TEXT,
                    v_loyalty_residual_minor,
                    p_request_id,
                    p_actor_id
                );
                v_loyalty_amount := COALESCE((v_loyalty_result ->> 'value_minor')::BIGINT, 0)::NUMERIC / 100;
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    v_payment_due := GREATEST(v_grand_total - v_gift_card_amount - v_loyalty_amount, 0);

    UPDATE orders
       SET shipping_cost = v_shipping_amount,
           shipping_method = v_shipping_method,
           tax = v_tax_amount,
           place_of_supply_state = COALESCE(p_place_of_supply_state, place_of_supply_state),
           discount = v_discount_amount,
           total = v_payment_due,
           coupon_code = NULLIF(UPPER(BTRIM(COALESCE(p_coupon_code, ''))), ''),
           coupon_discount = v_discount_amount,
           currency = COALESCE(currency, 'INR'),
           payment_status = CASE WHEN v_payment_due = 0 THEN 'paid' ELSE payment_status END,
           status = CASE WHEN v_payment_due = 0 THEN 'confirmed' ELSE status END,
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_order_id;

    IF p_tax_lines IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(p_tax_lines) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p_tax_lines) > 0 THEN
        FOR v_tax_line IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_tax_lines)
        LOOP
            INSERT INTO order_tax_lines (
                site_id,
                order_id,
                title,
                rate,
                amount,
                jurisdiction,
                metadata,
                created_by
            )
            VALUES (
                p_store_id,
                v_order_id,
                v_tax_line ->> 'title',
                COALESCE((v_tax_line ->> 'rate')::NUMERIC, 0),
                COALESCE((v_tax_line ->> 'amount')::NUMERIC, 0),
                COALESCE(v_tax_line -> 'jurisdiction', '{}'::JSONB),
                jsonb_build_object('source', 'create_checkout_order'),
                p_actor_id
            );
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO checkout_sessions (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        customer_email,
        status,
        idempotency_key,
        subtotal,
        shipping_total,
        tax_total,
        discount_total,
        gift_card_total,
        grand_total,
        currency,
        shipping_method,
        payment_method,
        request_id,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_store_id,
        v_order_id,
        p_customer_email,
        'completed',
        p_idempotency_key,
        COALESCE(v_order.subtotal, 0),
        v_shipping_amount,
        v_tax_amount,
        v_discount_amount,
        v_gift_card_amount,
        v_grand_total,
        COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
        v_shipping_method,
        p_payment_method,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'create_checkout_order', 'payment_due', v_payment_due, 'promotion', v_promotion),
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO order_shipping_lines (
        site_id,
        order_id,
        title,
        method,
        amount,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_store_id,
        v_order_id,
        CASE WHEN v_shipping_method = 'express' THEN 'Express Shipping' ELSE 'Standard Shipping' END,
        v_shipping_method,
        v_shipping_amount,
        jsonb_build_object('computed_by', 'create_checkout_order', 'shipping_rate_id', p_shipping_rate_id),
        p_actor_id
    );

    IF v_discount_amount > 0 THEN
        INSERT INTO order_line_adjustments (
            site_id,
            order_id,
            adjustment_type,
            source_type,
            source_id,
            title,
            amount,
            metadata,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            p_store_id,
            v_order_id,
            'promotion',
            CASE WHEN (v_promotion ->> 'promotion_id') IS NOT NULL THEN 'promotion' ELSE 'coupon' END,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'promotion_id', '')::UUID, NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'coupon_id', '')::UUID),
            COALESCE(v_promotion ->> 'title', 'Promotion'),
            v_discount_amount,
            v_promotion,
            p_actor_id
        );

        INSERT INTO promotion_redemptions (
            site_id,
            promotion_id,
            promotion_code_id,
            coupon_id,
            order_id,
            customer_email,
            code,
            amount,
            status,
            idempotency_key,
            request_id,
            metadata,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            p_store_id,
            NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'promotion_id', '')::UUID,
            NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'promotion_code_id', '')::UUID,
            NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'coupon_id', '')::UUID,
            v_order_id,
            p_customer_email,
            v_promotion ->> 'code',
            v_discount_amount,
            'committed',
            'promotion.redemption:' || v_order_id::TEXT || ':' || COALESCE(v_promotion ->> 'code', 'unknown'),
            p_request_id,
            v_promotion,
            p_actor_id
        )
        ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

        UPDATE promotion_codes
           SET usage_count = usage_count + 1,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'promotion_code_id', '')::UUID;

        UPDATE coupons
           SET usage_count = COALESCE(usage_count, 0) + 1,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'coupon_id', '')::UUID;

        INSERT INTO promotion_usage_counters (
            site_id,
            promotion_id,
            promotion_code_id,
            coupon_id,
            customer_email,
            usage_count
        )
        VALUES (
            p_store_id,
            NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'promotion_id', '')::UUID,
            NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'promotion_code_id', '')::UUID,
            NULLIF(v_promotion ->> 'coupon_id', '')::UUID,
            LOWER(p_customer_email),
            1
        )
        ON CONFLICT (site_id, promotion_id, promotion_code_id, coupon_id, customer_email)
        DO UPDATE SET usage_count = promotion_usage_counters.usage_count + 1,
                      updated_at = NOW();
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO payment_transactions (
        order_id,
        store_id,
        site_id,
        gateway,
        amount,
        currency,
        status,
        payment_method,
        metadata,
        request_id,
        idempotency_key,
        created_by,
        captured_at
    )
    VALUES (
        v_order_id,
        p_store_id,
        p_store_id,
        p_payment_method,
        v_payment_due,
        COALESCE(v_order.currency, 'INR'),
        CASE WHEN v_payment_due = 0 THEN 'captured' ELSE 'pending' END,
        p_payment_method,
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'checkout', 'gift_card_total', v_gift_card_amount),
        p_request_id,
        p_idempotency_key || ':payment',
        p_actor_id,
        CASE WHEN v_payment_due = 0 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id INTO v_payment_transaction_id;

    INSERT INTO inventory_events (
        site_id,
        inventory_level_id,
        location_id,
        product_id,
        variant_id,
        order_id,
        reservation_id,
        event_type,
        quantity_delta,
        on_hand_quantity,
        available_quantity,
        committed_quantity,
        unavailable_quantity,
        incoming_quantity,
        reserved_quantity,
        safety_stock_quantity,
        source_type,
        source_id,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        metadata,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        p_store_id,
        il.id,
        r.location_id,
        oi.product_id,
        NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '')::UUID,
        v_order_id,
        r.id,
        'sale_committed',
        -oi.quantity,
        COALESCE(il.on_hand_quantity, il.available + il.reserved),
        COALESCE(il.available_quantity, il.available),
        oi.quantity,
        COALESCE(il.unavailable_quantity, 0),
        COALESCE(il.incoming_quantity, il.incoming),
        COALESCE(il.reserved_quantity, il.reserved),
        COALESCE(il.safety_stock_quantity, 0),
        'order',
        v_order_id,
        'checkout.sale_committed:' || v_order_id::TEXT || ':' || oi.id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        jsonb_build_object('checkout_session_idempotency_key', p_idempotency_key),
        p_actor_id
      FROM order_items oi
      LEFT JOIN inventory_reservations r
        ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
       AND r.product_id = oi.product_id
       AND (
            (r.variant_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '') IS NULL)
            OR r.variant_id = NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '')::UUID
       )
       AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN inventory_levels il
        ON il.location_id = r.location_id
       AND il.product_id = oi.product_id
       AND (
            (il.variant_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '') IS NULL)
            OR il.variant_id = NULLIF(oi.variant_id, '')::UUID
       )
     WHERE oi.order_id = v_order_id
       AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL
    ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        site_id,
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        trace_id,
        schema_version,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        p_store_id,
        p_store_id,
        'checkout',
        v_order_id::TEXT,
        'checkout.completed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'site_id', p_store_id,
            'order_id', v_order_id,
            'payment_transaction_id', v_payment_transaction_id,
            'subtotal', COALESCE(v_order.subtotal, 0),
            'shipping_total', v_shipping_amount,
            'tax_total', v_tax_amount,
            'discount_total', v_discount_amount,
            'gift_card_total', v_gift_card_amount,
        'loyalty_total', v_loyalty_amount,
        'loyalty_points_applied', v_loyalty_points_applied,
            'grand_total', v_grand_total,
            'payment_due', v_payment_due,
            'schema_version', 1
        ),
        'checkout.completed:' || v_order_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        p_request_id,
        1,
        p_actor_id
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;

    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) item WHERE item ? 'cart_fact_ref') THEN
      UPDATE public.orders SET order_source='checkout',order_locked_at=coalesce(order_locked_at,now()) WHERE id=v_order_id AND store_id=p_store_id;
    END IF;
    SELECT to_jsonb(o)
      INTO v_order_json
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.id = v_order_id;

    RETURN v_order_json;
END;

DECLARE
    v_credential_id uuid;
    v_customer public.store_customers%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    IF p_store_id IS NULL
        OR p_email IS NULL
        OR p_email = ''
        OR p_email IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p_email))
        OR p_reset_token_hash IS NULL
        OR p_password_hash IS NULL
    THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    SELECT credential.id
      INTO v_credential_id
      FROM public.customer_credentials AS credential
     WHERE credential.store_id = p_store_id
       AND credential.email_or_phone = p_email
       AND credential.reset_token_hash = p_reset_token_hash
       AND credential.reset_used_at IS NULL
       AND credential.reset_expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    SELECT customer.*
      INTO v_customer
      FROM public.store_customers AS customer
     WHERE customer.store_id = p_store_id
       AND customer.email = p_email
       AND customer.status <> 'disabled'
       AND customer.deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.store_customers
       SET password_hash = p_password_hash,
           status = 'active'
     WHERE id = v_customer.id
       AND store_id = p_store_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     RETURNING * INTO v_customer;

    UPDATE public.customer_credentials
       SET password_hash = p_password_hash,
           reset_token_hash = NULL,
           reset_used_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
     WHERE id = v_credential_id
       AND store_id = p_store_id
       AND reset_token_hash = p_reset_token_hash
       AND reset_used_at IS NULL;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001', MESSAGE = 'Customer reset state changed during confirmation';
    END IF;

    RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v_customer.id,
        'store_id', v_customer.store_id,
        'email', v_customer.email,
        'full_name', v_customer.full_name,
        'phone', v_customer.phone,
        'status', v_customer.status,
        'accepts_marketing', v_customer.accepts_marketing,
        'updated_at', v_customer.updated_at
    );
END;

WITH requested AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT unnest(COALESCE(p_product_ids, ARRAY[]::uuid[])) AS product_id
    ),
    keys AS (
        SELECT p.id AS product_id, COALESCE(p.site_id, p.store_id) AS store_id, NULL::uuid AS variant_id
          FROM public.products p JOIN requested r ON r.product_id = p.id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT v.product_id, COALESCE(p.site_id, p.store_id), v.id
          FROM public.product_variants v JOIN requested r ON r.product_id = v.product_id
          JOIN public.products p ON p.id = v.product_id
    ),
    observed AS (
        SELECT h.product_id, h.variant_id, h.price, h.compare_price, h.observed_at, h.id, h.is_available,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id, h.variant_id ORDER BY h.observed_at DESC, h.id DESC) AS rn,
               lag(h.price) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id, h.variant_id ORDER BY h.observed_at, h.id) AS previous_price,
               lag(h.is_available) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id, h.variant_id ORDER BY h.observed_at, h.id) AS previous_available
          FROM public.product_price_observations h JOIN keys k
            ON k.product_id = h.product_id AND k.store_id = h.store_id
           AND k.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
         WHERE p_channel IN ('storefront', 'marketplace')
           AND h.offer_channel = p_channel AND h.observed_at <= COALESCE(p_as_of, now())
    ),
    latest AS (
        SELECT h.product_id, h.variant_id, h.price, h.compare_price, h.observed_at
          FROM observed h
         WHERE h.rn = 1
    ),
    anchors AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (h.product_id, h.variant_id)
               h.product_id, h.variant_id, h.observed_at AS reference_at
          FROM observed h
         WHERE (h.previous_price IS NOT NULL AND h.price IS DISTINCT FROM h.previous_price)
            OR (h.previous_available IS NOT NULL AND h.is_available IS DISTINCT FROM h.previous_available)
         ORDER BY h.product_id, h.variant_id, h.observed_at DESC, h.id DESC
    ),
    reference_points AS (
        SELECT l.product_id, l.variant_id, COALESCE(a.reference_at, l.observed_at) AS reference_at
          FROM latest l
          LEFT JOIN anchors a ON a.product_id = l.product_id AND a.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.variant_id
    ),
    boundary_ranked AS (
        SELECT h.product_id, h.variant_id, h.price, h.is_available,
               row_number() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY h.product_id, h.variant_id
                   ORDER BY h.observed_at DESC, h.id DESC
               ) AS rn
          FROM public.product_price_observations h
          JOIN keys k ON k.product_id = h.product_id AND k.store_id = h.store_id
                     AND k.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
          JOIN reference_points r ON r.product_id = h.product_id AND r.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
         WHERE p_channel IN ('storefront', 'marketplace')
           AND h.offer_channel = p_channel
           AND h.observed_at <= r.reference_at - interval '30 days'
    ),
    boundary AS (
        SELECT b.product_id, b.variant_id, b.price
          FROM boundary_ranked b
         WHERE b.rn = 1 AND b.is_available
    ),
    lowest AS (
        SELECT points.product_id, points.variant_id, min(points.price) AS prior_lowest_price_30d
          FROM (
                SELECT * FROM boundary
                UNION ALL
                SELECT h.product_id, h.variant_id, h.price
                  FROM public.product_price_observations h
                  JOIN keys k ON k.product_id = h.product_id AND k.store_id = h.store_id
                             AND k.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
                  JOIN reference_points r ON r.product_id = h.product_id AND r.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
                 WHERE p_channel IN ('storefront', 'marketplace')
                   AND h.offer_channel = p_channel AND h.is_available
                   AND h.observed_at > r.reference_at - interval '30 days'
                   AND h.observed_at < r.reference_at
          ) points GROUP BY points.product_id, points.variant_id
    ),
    coverage AS (
        SELECT h.product_id, h.variant_id, min(h.observed_at) AS coverage_start_at,
               bool_or(h.observed_at <= r.reference_at - interval '30 days') AS coverage_complete
          FROM public.product_price_observations h
          JOIN keys k ON k.product_id = h.product_id AND k.store_id = h.store_id
                     AND k.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
          JOIN reference_points r ON r.product_id = h.product_id AND r.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.variant_id
         WHERE p_channel IN ('storefront', 'marketplace')
           AND h.offer_channel = p_channel AND h.observed_at <= r.reference_at
         GROUP BY h.product_id, h.variant_id
    )
    SELECT k.product_id, k.variant_id, l.price, l.compare_price, low.prior_lowest_price_30d,
           COALESCE(c.coverage_complete, false), l.observed_at, c.coverage_start_at, l.observed_at
      FROM keys k
      LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.product_id = k.product_id AND l.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.variant_id
      LEFT JOIN lowest low ON low.product_id = k.product_id AND low.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.variant_id
      LEFT JOIN coverage c ON c.product_id = k.product_id AND c.variant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.variant_id;

SELECT
    cl.id,
    p.id,
    s.id,
    s.store_name,
    s.subdomain,
    p.name,
    p.slug,
    p.images,
    p.price,
    p.compare_price,
    mc.slug,
    cl.approved_at,
    p.country_of_origin
  FROM public.channel_listings cl
  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = cl.product_id
  JOIN public.sites s ON s.id = cl.site_id
  LEFT JOIN public.marketplace_categories mc ON mc.id = cl.marketplace_category_id
  WHERE cl.channel = 'marketplace'
    AND cl.status = 'approved'
    AND cl.visibility = 'public'
    AND p.is_active = true
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.status = 'published'
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (p_category_slug IS NULL OR mc.slug = p_category_slug)
    AND (
      p_search IS NULL OR length(btrim(p_search)) = 0
      OR p.name ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(btrim(p_search), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\'
    )
    AND (
      p_country_of_origin IS NULL
      OR lower(btrim(p.country_of_origin)) = lower(btrim(p_country_of_origin))
    )
    AND (
      p_after_approved_at IS NULL OR p_after_id IS NULL
      OR (cl.approved_at, cl.id) < (p_after_approved_at, p_after_id)
    )
  ORDER BY cl.approved_at DESC, cl.id DESC
  LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 100));

SELECT min(btrim(p.country_of_origin)) AS country_of_origin
  FROM public.channel_listings cl
  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = cl.product_id
  JOIN public.sites s ON s.id = cl.site_id
  WHERE cl.channel = 'marketplace'
    AND cl.status = 'approved'
    AND cl.visibility = 'public'
    AND p.is_active = true
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.status = 'published'
    AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.country_of_origin IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim(p.country_of_origin)) > 0
  GROUP BY lower(btrim(p.country_of_origin))
  ORDER BY lower(min(btrim(p.country_of_origin)))
  LIMIT 200;

SELECT jsonb_build_object(

    ),

      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(

        'compare_price', v.compare_price,
        'weight', v.weight,
        'weight_unit', v.weight_unit,

      ) ORDER BY o.position, o.created_at, o.id)
      FROM public.product_options o WHERE o.product_id = p.id

  )
  FROM public.channel_listings cl
  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = cl.product_id
  WHERE cl.id = p_listing_id AND cl.channel = 'marketplace';

DECLARE
  v_has_locked_checkout boolean;
  v_marketplace_binding boolean;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.orders AS order_row
       WHERE order_row.id = OLD.order_id
         AND order_row.order_source = 'checkout'
         AND order_row.order_locked_at IS NOT NULL
    ) INTO v_has_locked_checkout;
    IF v_has_locked_checkout THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'checkout order item commercial snapshot is immutable';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  v_marketplace_binding := OLD.marketplace_listing_id IS NULL
    AND OLD.marketplace_approved_fingerprint IS NULL
    AND OLD.marketplace_category_id IS NULL
    AND NEW.marketplace_listing_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.marketplace_approved_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.marketplace_category_id IS NOT NULL
    AND current_setting('app.marketplace_order_creation', true) = 'on';

  IF OLD.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_id
     OR OLD.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.product_id
     OR OLD.variant_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.variant_id
     OR OLD.name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.name
     OR OLD.sku IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sku
     OR OLD.quantity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.quantity
     OR OLD.price IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.price
     OR OLD.total IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.total
     OR OLD.title IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.title
     OR OLD.variant_title IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.variant_title
     OR OLD.unit_price IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.unit_price
     OR OLD.discount_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.discount_amount
     OR OLD.tax_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.tax_amount
     OR OLD.product_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.product_snapshot
     OR OLD.hsn_code IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.hsn_code
     OR OLD.gst_rate IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.gst_rate
     OR OLD.taxable_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.taxable_amount
     OR OLD.cgst_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.cgst_amount
     OR OLD.sgst_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sgst_amount
     OR OLD.igst_amount IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.igst_amount
     OR OLD.deleted_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deleted_at
     OR (OLD.marketplace_category_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.marketplace_category_id AND NOT v_marketplace_binding) THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.orders AS order_row
       WHERE order_row.id IN (OLD.order_id, NEW.order_id)
         AND order_row.order_source = 'checkout'
         AND order_row.order_locked_at IS NOT NULL
    ) INTO v_has_locked_checkout;
    IF v_has_locked_checkout THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'checkout order item commercial snapshot is immutable';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;

DECLARE
  v_transaction public.ledger_transactions%ROWTYPE;
  v_projection public.wallet_ledger_entries%ROWTYPE;
  v_projection_count integer;
  v_payable_delta bigint;
  v_amount_minor bigint;
  v_direction text;
  v_idempotency_key text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_transaction
    FROM public.ledger_transactions
   WHERE id = p_transaction_id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF v_transaction.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'refund'
     AND v_transaction.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'reversal'
     AND NOT (
       v_transaction.source_type = 'settlement'
       AND v_transaction.metadata->>'ledger_role' = 'fee_assessment'
     ) THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE entry.side WHEN 'credit' THEN entry.amount_minor ELSE -entry.amount_minor END
  ), 0)::bigint
    INTO v_payable_delta
    FROM public.ledger_entries AS entry
    JOIN public.ledger_accounts AS account
      ON account.id = entry.account_id
     AND account.site_id = entry.site_id
   WHERE entry.transaction_id = v_transaction.id
     AND entry.site_id = v_transaction.site_id
     AND entry.currency = v_transaction.currency
     AND account.account_code = 'merchant_payable'
     AND entry.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND account.deleted_at IS NULL;

  IF v_payable_delta = 0 THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  v_amount_minor := abs(v_payable_delta);
  v_direction := CASE WHEN v_payable_delta > 0 THEN 'credit' ELSE 'debit' END;
  v_idempotency_key := 'canonical-money-projection:' || v_transaction.id::text;

  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_projection_count
    FROM public.wallet_ledger_entries
   WHERE site_id = v_transaction.site_id
     AND canonical_ledger_transaction_id = v_transaction.id
     AND deleted_at IS NULL;

  IF v_projection_count > 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical transaction % has duplicate wallet projections', v_transaction.id;
  ELSIF v_projection_count = 1 THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_projection
      FROM public.wallet_ledger_entries
     WHERE site_id = v_transaction.site_id
       AND canonical_ledger_transaction_id = v_transaction.id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_projection.entry_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'adjustment'
       OR v_projection.direction IS DISTINCT FROM v_direction
       OR v_projection.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
       OR v_projection.currency IS DISTINCT FROM v_transaction.currency
       OR v_projection.amount_minor_bigint IS DISTINCT FROM v_amount_minor THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical transaction % conflicts with its wallet projection', v_transaction.id;
    END IF;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.wallet_ledger_entries (
    site_id,
    entry_type,
    direction,
    status,
    currency,
    amount_minor,
    amount_minor_bigint,
    reference_type,
    reference_id,
    description,
    idempotency_key,
    canonical_ledger_transaction_id,
    metadata,
    created_by,
    updated_by
  ) VALUES (
    v_transaction.site_id,
    'adjustment',
    v_direction,
    'posted',
    v_transaction.currency,
    LEAST(v_amount_minor, 2147483647)::integer,
    v_amount_minor,
    'ledger_transaction',
    v_transaction.id::text,
    CASE
      WHEN v_transaction.source_type = 'refund' THEN 'Canonical merchant payable refund'
      WHEN v_transaction.source_type = 'reversal' THEN 'Canonical merchant payable reversal'
      ELSE 'Canonical payout fee assessment'
    END,
    v_idempotency_key,
    v_transaction.id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'projection_source_type', v_transaction.source_type,
      'projection_source_id', v_transaction.source_id,
      'projection_reason', CASE
        WHEN v_transaction.source_type = 'refund' THEN 'refund'
        WHEN v_transaction.source_type = 'reversal' THEN 'reversal'
        ELSE 'payout_fee_assessment'
      END
    ),
    v_transaction.created_by,
    v_transaction.updated_by
  )
  ON CONFLICT (site_id, idempotency_key)
    WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
  DO NOTHING;

  SELECT * INTO v_projection
    FROM public.wallet_ledger_entries
   WHERE site_id = v_transaction.site_id
     AND idempotency_key = v_idempotency_key
     AND deleted_at IS NULL
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND
     OR v_projection.canonical_ledger_transaction_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_transaction.id
     OR v_projection.entry_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'adjustment'
     OR v_projection.direction IS DISTINCT FROM v_direction
     OR v_projection.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted'
     OR v_projection.currency IS DISTINCT FROM v_transaction.currency
     OR v_projection.amount_minor_bigint IS DISTINCT FROM v_amount_minor THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'wallet projection idempotency key conflicts for canonical transaction %', v_transaction.id;
  END IF;
END;

DECLARE
  v_order record;
  v_transaction_count integer;
  v_origin_count integer;
  v_delta_minor bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_payout_statement_id IS NULL OR p_site_id IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_source_order_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'payout source lineage payload is invalid' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  FOR v_order IN
    SELECT order_row.id,
           round(order_row.total * 100)::bigint AS gross_minor
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_source_order_ids, '[]'::jsonb)) AS source_order(value)
      JOIN public.orders AS order_row ON order_row.id::text = source_order.value
     WHERE order_row.site_id = p_site_id
       AND order_row.store_id = p_site_id
       AND order_row.deleted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY order_row.id
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.payout_statement_source_orders (
      site_id, payout_statement_id, order_id, source_order_gross_minor
    ) VALUES (
      p_site_id, p_payout_statement_id, v_order.id, v_order.gross_minor
    )
    ON CONFLICT (payout_statement_id, site_id, order_id) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO public.payout_statement_source_ledger_transactions (
      site_id, payout_statement_id, order_id, ledger_transaction_id,
      source_type, merchant_payable_delta_minor, ledger_created_at
    )
    SELECT p_site_id,
           p_payout_statement_id,
           v_order.id,
           transaction_row.id,
           transaction_row.source_type,
           COALESCE(sum(CASE entry_row.side WHEN 'credit' THEN entry_row.amount_minor ELSE -entry_row.amount_minor END)
             FILTER (WHERE account_row.account_code = 'merchant_payable'), 0)::bigint,
           transaction_row.created_at
      FROM public.ledger_transactions AS transaction_row
      JOIN public.ledger_entries AS entry_row
        ON entry_row.transaction_id = transaction_row.id
       AND entry_row.site_id = transaction_row.site_id
       AND entry_row.deleted_at IS NULL
      JOIN public.ledger_accounts AS account_row
        ON account_row.id = entry_row.account_id
       AND account_row.site_id = transaction_row.site_id
       AND account_row.deleted_at IS NULL
     WHERE transaction_row.site_id = p_site_id
       AND transaction_row.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND transaction_row.source_type IN ('payment_capture', 'cod_remittance', 'refund', 'reversal')
       AND transaction_row.metadata->>'order_id' = v_order.id::text
       AND transaction_row.created_at <= p_statement_created_at
       AND (
         (transaction_row.source_type = 'payment_capture' AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.payment_transactions AS payment_transaction
            WHERE payment_transaction.site_id = p_site_id
              AND payment_transaction.order_id = v_order.id
              AND payment_transaction.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND (
                payment_transaction.id::text = transaction_row.metadata->>'payment_transaction_id'
                OR payment_transaction.provider_payment_id = transaction_row.metadata->>'provider_payment_id'
              )
         ))
         OR (transaction_row.source_type = 'cod_remittance' AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.cod_reconciliation_entries AS cod_entry
            WHERE cod_entry.site_id = p_site_id
              AND cod_entry.order_id = v_order.id
              AND cod_entry.id::text = transaction_row.source_id
              AND cod_entry.deleted_at IS NULL
         ))
         OR (transaction_row.source_type = 'refund' AND (
           EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM public.refunds AS refund_row
              WHERE refund_row.site_id = p_site_id
                AND refund_row.order_id = v_order.id
                AND refund_row.id::text = transaction_row.metadata->>'refund_id'
                AND refund_row.deleted_at IS NULL
           )
           OR EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM public.payment_transactions AS payment_transaction
              WHERE payment_transaction.site_id = p_site_id
                AND payment_transaction.order_id = v_order.id
                AND payment_transaction.deleted_at IS NULL
                AND payment_transaction.id::text = transaction_row.metadata->>'payment_transaction_id'
           )
         ))
         OR (transaction_row.source_type = 'reversal' AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.ledger_transactions AS original_transaction
            WHERE original_transaction.id = transaction_row.reversal_of
              AND original_transaction.site_id = p_site_id
              AND original_transaction.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND original_transaction.metadata->>'order_id' = v_order.id::text
         ))
       )
     GROUP BY transaction_row.id, transaction_row.source_type, transaction_row.created_at
    ON CONFLICT (payout_statement_id, order_id, ledger_transaction_id) DO NOTHING;

    SELECT count(*)::integer,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE source_type IN ('payment_capture', 'cod_remittance'))::integer,
           COALESCE(sum(merchant_payable_delta_minor), 0)::bigint
      INTO v_transaction_count, v_origin_count, v_delta_minor
      FROM public.payout_statement_source_ledger_transactions
     WHERE site_id = p_site_id
       AND payout_statement_id = p_payout_statement_id
       AND order_id = v_order.id;

    UPDATE public.payout_statement_source_orders
       SET canonical_merchant_payable_delta_minor = v_delta_minor,
           canonical_transaction_count = v_transaction_count,
           origin_transaction_count = v_origin_count,
           lineage_status = CASE
             WHEN v_origin_count > 0 THEN 'linked'
             WHEN v_transaction_count > 0 THEN 'adjustment_only'
             ELSE 'missing'
           END
     WHERE site_id = p_site_id
       AND payout_statement_id = p_payout_statement_id
       AND order_id = v_order.id;
  END LOOP;
END;

DECLARE s public.sites%ROWTYPE;c public.billing_history%ROWTYPE;receipt uuid:=gen_random_uuid();amount bigint;scope text;free_quote boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.sites WHERE id=p_site AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT coalesce(p_actor=s.custom_user_id OR p_actor=s.user_id,false) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_OWNER_REQUIRED'); END IF;
 -- The table admission lock is already held by the store SELECT above. A
 -- call compiled before rollback may have waited on that lock; verify the
 -- currently bound function's own SET attribute, not the caller/session GUC.
 -- Read the live catalog binding even for a cached frame; admit exact supported versions only.
 IF p_quote->>'mode'='free_activation' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc current_binding
  WHERE current_binding.oid='public.claim_merchant_subscription_checkout_v1(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb)'::pg_catalog.regprocedure
   AND current_binding.proconfig && ARRAY['application_name=claim_merchant_subscription_checkout_v1:347','application_name=claim_merchant_subscription_checkout_v1:347:360']::text[]) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_CONTEXT_INVALID'); END IF;
 IF nullif(btrim(p_key),'') IS NULL OR length(p_key)>200 OR jsonb_typeof(p_request) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_CONTEXT_INVALID'); END IF;
 scope:='subscription.checkout:'||p_actor;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(scope||':'||p_site||':'||p_key,0));
 SELECT * INTO c FROM public.billing_history WHERE site_id=p_site AND user_id=p_actor AND subscription_checkout_key=p_key FOR UPDATE;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR c.subscription_checkout_request IS DISTINCT FROM p_request THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_CHECKOUT_CONFLICT'); END IF;
  IF c.amount>0 AND c.subscription_tax_snapshot IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_TAX_REVIEW_REQUIRED');END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',true,'claimed',false,'charge',to_jsonb(c));
 END IF;
 IF p_quote IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',true,'missing',true); END IF;
 -- 347: one discriminated internal free quote alongside unchanged paid modes.
 amount:=(p_quote->>'amount_minor')::bigint;
 free_quote:=p_quote->>'mode'='free_activation';
 IF amount IS NULL OR amount<0 OR amount>2147483647 OR (NOT free_quote AND amount=0) OR p_quote->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM 'INR'
  OR p_quote->>'mode' IS NULL OR p_quote->>'mode' NOT IN('razorpay_order','razorpay_subscription','sandbox_activation','free_activation') OR p_quote->'plan'->>'slug' IS DISTINCT FROM p_request->>'plan_slug'
  OR p_request->>'billing_period' IS NULL OR p_request->>'billing_period' NOT IN('monthly','yearly')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.plans WHERE id=(p_quote->'plan'->>'id')::uuid AND slug=p_request->>'plan_slug' AND site_type=s.site_type AND is_active=true) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_CONTEXT_INVALID'); END IF;
 IF free_quote AND (amount<>0 OR p_request->>'site_type' IS DISTINCT FROM s.site_type
  OR p_quote?'provider_input' OR p_quote->'response'->>'checkout_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'free_activation'
  OR p_quote->'response'->>'amount' IS DISTINCT FROM '0' OR p_quote->'response'->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM 'INR'
  OR p_quote->'response'->>'billing_period' IS DISTINCT FROM p_request->>'billing_period'
  OR p_quote->'response'->>'recurring' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'
  OR p_quote->'response'->>'is_promo' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.plans p WHERE p.id=(p_quote->'plan'->>'id')::uuid
   AND CASE WHEN p_request->>'billing_period'='yearly' THEN coalesce(p.price_yearly_inr,p.price_monthly_inr*12) ELSE p.price_monthly_inr END=0)) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_CONTEXT_INVALID'); END IF;
 -- The native quote freezes separate initial/base components and the exact
 -- provider-plan read admitted by the backend before claim. No scheduled-start
 -- or additional provider-tax semantics are inferred at the SQL boundary.
 IF p_quote->>'mode'='razorpay_subscription' AND (
  p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'start_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'immediate'
  OR NOT coalesce((p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'base_gross_minor')~'^[1-9][0-9]*$',false)
  OR NOT coalesce((p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'upfront_gross_minor')~'^[0-9]+$',false)
  OR p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'initial_gross_minor' IS DISTINCT FROM amount::text
  OR (p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'base_gross_minor')::numeric+(p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'upfront_gross_minor')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM amount::numeric
  OR p_quote->'provider_input'?'start_at'
  OR p_quote->'provider_input'->>'quantity' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR NOT coalesce((p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'provider_plan_id')~'^plan_[A-Za-z0-9]+$',false)
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'provider_plan_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_quote->'provider_input'->>'plan_id'
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'base_gross_minor' IS DISTINCT FROM p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'base_gross_minor'
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM 'INR'
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'billing_period' IS DISTINCT FROM p_request->>'billing_period'
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'interval' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR p_quote->'provider_plan_binding'->>'tax_configuration' IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_additional_tax'
  OR NOT public.valid_subscription_tax_snapshot_360(p_quote->'recurring_tax_snapshot')
  OR p_quote->'recurring_tax_snapshot'->>'gross_minor' IS DISTINCT FROM p_quote->'charge_schedule'->>'base_gross_minor'
  OR p_quote->'recurring_tax_snapshot'->'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'profile'
  OR p_quote->'recurring_tax_snapshot'->'recipient' IS DISTINCT FROM p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'recipient'
  OR ((p_quote->'recurring_tax_snapshot'->'source')-'gross_before_discount_minor') IS DISTINCT FROM ((p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source')-'gross_before_discount_minor')) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_TAX_SETUP_REQUIRED');END IF;
 IF NOT free_quote AND (NOT public.valid_subscription_tax_snapshot_360(p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot')
  OR p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source'->>'actor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor::text
  OR p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source'->>'site_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_site::text
  OR p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source'->>'request_key' IS DISTINCT FROM p_key
  OR p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source'->>'plan_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_quote->'plan'->>'id'
  OR p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source'->>'plan_slug' IS DISTINCT FROM p_request->>'plan_slug'
  OR p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->'source'->>'billing_period' IS DISTINCT FROM p_request->>'billing_period'
  OR (p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot'->>'gross_minor')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM amount
  OR (p_quote->'response'->>'amount')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM amount
  OR p_quote->'response'->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM 'INR'
  OR (p_quote->>'mode'='razorpay_order' AND (p_quote->'provider_input'->>'amount')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM amount)) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_TAX_SETUP_REQUIRED'); END IF;
 -- A pre-347 HTTP receipt can outlive the old unbound free activation. It
 -- cannot be guessed from the latest subscription or its creation time. After
 -- canonical route ownership is installed, refuse this ambiguous legacy key
 -- rather than creating a second outcome. Existing canonical quotes replay above.
 IF free_quote AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.idempotency_keys old_http
  WHERE old_http.site_id=p_site AND old_http.key=btrim(p_key) AND old_http.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND old_http.scope IN('http:POST:/payments/subscription/order','http:POST:/payments/subscription/recover')) THEN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',false,'code','SUBSCRIPTION_LEGACY_CHECKOUT_PENDING'); END IF;

  payment_status,billing_period,subscription_checkout,subscription_checkout_key,subscription_checkout_request,subscription_checkout_reference,subscription_tax_snapshot,subscription_tax_source_id)
 VALUES(receipt,p_actor,p_site,p_site,'QUOTE-'||receipt,'Pending subscription checkout',amount,amount,'INR',CASE WHEN free_quote THEN NULL ELSE 'razorpay' END,'pending',
  p_request->>'billing_period',p_quote,p_key,p_request,CASE WHEN free_quote THEN 'free_checkout:'||receipt ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN free_quote THEN NULL ELSE p_quote->'subscription_tax_snapshot' END,CASE WHEN free_quote THEN NULL ELSE receipt END) RETURNING * INTO c;
 INSERT INTO public.idempotency_keys(site_id,key,scope,request_hash,resource_type,resource_id,expires_at)
 VALUES(p_site,p_key,scope,encode(sha256(convert_to(p_request::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'billing_history',receipt,'infinity');
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('accepted',true,'claimed',true,'charge',to_jsonb(c));
END

    AND c.entry_type='refund_credit' AND c.order_id=e.order_id AND c.loyalty_account_id=e.loyalty_account_id AND c.points=e.points
    AND c.metadata=jsonb_build_object('redeemed_entry_id',e.id,'points',e.points,
     'point_value_minor_at_redemption',e.metadata->>'point_value_minor','value_minor_at_redemption',e.metadata->>'value_minor'))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_queue_jobs j WHERE j.queue_name='loyalty-refunds'
    AND j.idempotency_key='loyalty.refund_restore:'||e.id::text)
  ORDER BY e.created_at,e.id LIMIT least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,25),1),100)
 ), inserted AS(

  OR OLD.state='received_unprocessed' OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at
